title: Risk Analytics - AI Governance - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Consulting – AI Governance – Manager**
The opportunity: your next adventure awaits
  
  
Are you a technology savvy risk professional passionate about Responsible AI and eager to help organizations embed trust, ethics, and governance into their AI journeys? EY Risk Consulting is expanding its AI Governance and Responsible AI practice, and we are looking for a manager who can bridge AI technology, risk management, and governance to create meaningful impact for our clients.
  
  
In this client facing role, you will work with global organizations to operationalize Responsible AI, design and assess AI governance frameworks, evaluate AI/ML risks at a use case level, and test the effectiveness of controls. You will help clients move from high level AI principles to real, on the ground implementation, backed by robust risk assessments, root cause analysis, and actionable recommendations.
  
  
**The role**
As a Manager within Risk Consulting – AI Governance, you will lead complex engagements at the intersection of risk management, AI/ML, and Responsible AI. You will advise clients on how AI principles (fairness, transparency, accountability, safety, robustness, privacy) are embedded across the AI lifecycle and how governance, controls, and assurance mechanisms are established and tested.
  
  
This role is ideal for professionals who either:
  
  

* Bring strong Risk Management experience with Responsible AI, OR
* Have hands on AI/ML experience with Responsible AI operationalization, including root cause analysis and solutioning.

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client Advisory & Delivery**

* Lead and deliver AI Governance and Responsible AI engagements, ensuring high quality outcomes within timelines and budgets.
* Advise clients on embedding Responsible AI principles across the AI lifecycle—from ideation and design to deployment and monitoring.
* Design, assess, and implement AI governance frameworks, policies, standards, and operating models.
* Perform AI use case–level risk assessments, identifying ethical, regulatory, operational, model, data, and technology risks.
* Define risk and control matrices (RCMs) for AI/ML systems aligned to leading frameworks and regulations.
* Test the design and operating effectiveness of AI controls, including governance, model risk, data, security, and monitoring controls.
* Conduct root cause analysis for AI-related issues and incidents and guide clients on practical remediation solutions.
* Develop clear, actionable recommendations and executive ready reports for senior stakeholders.

**Responsible AI & Technology**

* Support clients in operationalizing Responsible AI beyond principles—into processes, controls, tools, and metrics.
* Assess AI/ML systems including traditional ML and Generative AI / Agentic AI applications.
* Guide clients on model risk management, human in the loop controls, explainability, bias mitigation, and monitoring.
* Stay current on evolving AI regulations, standards, and best practices (e.g., EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, OECD).

**Stakeholder & Team Leadership**

* Manage day to day client relationships and act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders.
* Lead, mentor, and develop team members; review work products and provide constructive feedback.
* Actively contribute to practice growth, solution development, thought leadership, and go to market initiatives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of AI risks, Responsible AI principles, and AI governance.
* Ability to translate complex AI concepts into practical risk and control solutions.
* Experience performing use case driven risk assessments and control testing.
* Excellent client relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Clear, concise, and confident written and verbal communication.
* Strong project management skills, including planning, tracking, and risk management.
* Curious, technology enthusiastic mindset with a passion for continuous learning.
* Structured thinking, problem solving ability, and attention to detail.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 5+ years of experience in Risk Advisory, AI Risk, Technology Risk, Internal Audit, or AI/ML roles within Big 4 or comparable consulting/technology environments.
* Hands on Responsible AI implementation experience (non negotiable)—either from a risk/governance or AI/ML execution perspective.
* Proven experience in one or more of the following:

+ AI Risk Management & Governance
+ Responsible AI operationalization
+ AI/ML model risk assessments
+ Root cause analysis and remediation design

* Strong understanding of AI systems, data pipelines, and AI deployment lifecycles.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.

**Good to have**

* Professional certifications such as AIGP, ISO 42001, CISA, CISM, CRISC, CISSP, ISO 27001, or similar.
* Working knowledge of Python, ML concepts, or AI tooling to assess implementations effectively.

**What We Look For**

* Professionals who combine risk acumen, technology depth, and business mindset.
* Leaders who can engage confidently with clients and inspire teams.
* Individuals who are proactive, hands on, and excited by the evolving AI landscape.

**What Working At EY Offers**

* Exposure to market leading AI governance and Responsible AI engagements.
* An environment focused on learning, coaching, and career progression.
* Opportunities to work with global clients and cutting edge AI use cases.
* Flexibility, collaboration, and a culture built on trust and inclusion.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Risk Analytics - Audit Analytics - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Audit Analytics - Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Manager – Audit Analytics, you will lead the design and delivery of data analytics solutions across Internal Audit, risk and controls engagements. You will partner with audit, business, technology and data stakeholders to translate risk and control objectives into scalable analytical solutions while providing technical oversight and driving high-quality delivery across teams.
  
  
The role provides an opportunity to drive Internal Audit transformation through data analytics, automation, Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM), AI/GenAI and modern data technologies. You will also contribute to business development through solutioning, proposals and RFPs, effort estimation, solution architecture and commercial discussions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of audit analytics, from understanding audit objectives and identifying data requirements through development, validation and presentation of results.
* Drive Internal Audit transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to embed analytics, automation, AI/GenAI and technology-enabled approaches across the audit lifecycle.
* Lead solutioning for proposals, RFPs and RFIs, including understanding requirements, defining the analytics approach, developing solution architecture, estimating effort and supporting pricing and commercial discussions.
* Translate business, audit, risk and control requirements into analytical approaches, test logic, KRIs and exception scenarios.
* Provide technical direction and review across SQL, Python, ETL, Power BI and Snowflake/Databricks-based analytical solutions.
* Lead data profiling, transformation, reconciliation and validation activities across large and complex enterprise datasets.
* Design and oversee development of Power BI dashboards and analytical reporting that translate complex findings into clear risk and business insights.
* Partner with Internal Audit, business, technology and data stakeholders to identify data sources, resolve data challenges and drive analytics delivery.
* Review analytical logic, outputs and documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, scalability and alignment with audit objectives.
* Identify opportunities for automation, reusable analytics and Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM).
* Manage delivery plans, priorities, risks, resources and stakeholder expectations across multiple analytics initiatives.
* Coach and guide team members on analytics development, risk understanding and delivery quality.
* Allocate work, provide technical oversight and ensure teams have the appropriate direction and support to deliver against engagement objectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong experience leading Audit Analytics, Risk Analytics, Controls Analytics or similar data analytics engagements.
* Strong understanding of Internal Audit, risk and controls concepts, including risk assessment, control testing, KRIs, exception testing and audit analytics.
* Experience with RFP/RFI responses, solutioning, effort estimation, proposal development and pricing for analytics, Internal Audit or risk-related engagements.
* Strong hands-on understanding of SQL, with the ability to design and review complex analytical queries, data transformations and testing logic.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, transformation, statistical modelling, automation and development of scalable analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of ETL, data transformation, data quality and reconciliation techniques.
* Experience designing and reviewing dashboards and analytical solutions using Power BI.
* Strong experience working with Snowflake and/or Databricks in enterprise data environments.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI solutions and Large Language Models (LLMs), with the ability to identify opportunities for their application across analytics, audit and risk management engagements.
* Experience driving or contributing to Internal Audit transformation through adoption of analytics, automation, continuous monitoring and modern data technologies.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate analytical approaches, technical concepts and findings to audit, business and leadership stakeholders.
* Strong project and team management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and guide teams toward high-quality delivery.
* Have experience across business and technology processes such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P/PTP), Order-to-Cash (O2C/OTC), Travel & Expense (T&E), ITGC and SOX controls.
* Have experience working with enterprise systems and datasets such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, expense platforms, GRC tools or other ERP environments.
* We are looking for an experienced Audit Analytics leader who combines strong technical expertise with a sound understanding of Internal Audit, risk and controls. You should be comfortable leading end-to-end analytics delivery, providing technical direction to teams and translating complex analytical findings into clear risk and business insights.
* You should bring a solution-oriented and transformation mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities for analytics, automation, AI/GenAI and continuous monitoring across the Internal Audit lifecycle. The role also requires strong stakeholder management and commercial capabilities to contribute to proposals, RFPs, solutioning and development of scalable analytics offerings.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
CortixIQ Global Intelligence is an independent decision-intelligence and research firm founded in 2023. The company provides ROI-based software research, Intelligence Matrix evaluations, market research, product marketing, and market intelligence. CortixIQ supports evidence-based investments and delivers data-driven transparency for complex technology decisions. Team members contribute to impactful, research-driven insights that help clients make confident technology and investment choices.
  
**Role Description**
The Data Analyst role is a full-time remote position focused on transforming complex data into clear, actionable insights for internal and client-facing projects. Day-to-day responsibilities include collecting, cleaning, and organizing data from multiple sources, performing quantitative analyses, and building data models to support decision-intelligence and market research initiatives. The Data Analyst will prepare visualizations, dashboards, and reports that communicate key findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. The role also involves collaborating with research, product marketing, and leadership teams to refine hypotheses, validate assumptions, and support evidence-based recommendations.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and proven experience in Data Analytics.
* Candidates should possess a solid foundation in Statistics and experience applying statistical methods to real-world datasets.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in Data Modeling and working with structured and unstructured data.
* Candidates should possess clear and effective Communication skills, including the ability to present complex information to diverse audiences.
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar) and SQL or Python for data analysis is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or related discipline is preferred.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.
* Experience in market research, product marketing analytics, or technology industry analysis is an advantage.

title: Data Analyst, Global Supply Chain
description:
As a global leader in precision measurement sensing technologies, VPG addresses an expanding array of applications in which accuracy, reliability, and repeatability make the difference. Whether in the design and safety of new generations of cars, trucks, and planes or optimizing advanced medical equipment and consumer products, VPG’s deep engineering expertise makes the world safer, smarter, and more productive.

We are seeking a highly motivated Data Analyst to join our Global Supply Chain team on a full-time basis:

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a highly analytical and business-oriented Data Analyst to support our Global Supply Chain organization. The role is responsible for transforming data into actionable insights, improving decision-making, ensuring data integrity, and driving automation and reporting across Procurement, Planning, Inventory, Manufacturing, and Logistics functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze data from multiple systems and sources to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and management reports.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Create automated reports, workflows, and data solutions that reduce manual effort.
* Partner with global stakeholders to translate business needs into analytical insights and reporting tools.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong business acumen and ability to connect data with business outcomes.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management in a global environment.

Requirements:

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Supply Chain Analytics.
* Experience working in a global, multi-site environment.
* Strong knowledge of Supply Chain processes, including Planning, Procurement, Inventory, and Logistics.
* Advanced SQL skills and experience with Power BI or similar visualization tools.
* Experience with data automation, data validation, and dashboard development.
* Knowledge of ERP systems (QAD, SAP, Oracle, or similar).
* Experience with Python, Power Query, or other analytics tools is an advantage.

title: Retail Business Analyst
description:

title: Financial Services Business Analyst (GCC)
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
Beyond the traditional business of furnishing credit reports to lenders, TransUnion provides financial institutions in both mature and emerging markets with data and solutions to enhance and support their customer relationships. We have a large, diverse client base ranging from national banks and credit unions to small, independent lenders. We offer a broad array of solutions customized to each aspect of our clients’ business including credit risk management, digital marketing, fraud and ID management, and collections and recovery.
  
  
At TransUnion, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring innovative ideas and solutions to market, leveraging our extensive experience in credit data and analytics. The U.S. Financial Services vertical has a dynamic blend of experiences in financial services and credit risk management. As our team grows, we are looking for innovative and diverse talent to help us develop deep customer and market expertise to inform solution development and accelerate our growth. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

* A minimum of 2-4 years’ experience in a rigorous business analyst role with demonstrated experience completing market research, performing financial analysis and preparing business communications and presentations
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with demonstrated experience extracting insights from large datasets
* Aptitude leveraging business intelligence tools and writing intermediate SQL queries for data extraction
* Familiarity with R, Python or SAS or other data mining or statistical software is desired
* Proficiency building reports and graphics, with experience leveraging data visualization tools, such as Tableau, preferred
* Advanced experience with the MS Office suite, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint to carry out and communicate the results of analysis
* BS or advanced degree in statistics, industrial engineering, mathematics, economics, computer science, finance, or related field
* A track record of outstanding academic performance
* High level of English language proficiency in both verbal and written dimensions
* Strong time management skills with the ability to prioritize and contribute to multiple assignments simultaneously with evolving deadlines.

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* Leverage extensive datasets and various statistical software applications to develop and execute strategic quantitative analysis
* Investigate and report on complex data interactions to help identify and address our clients’ key strategic business opportunities
* Create statistical data models to be used as tools in the development of client portfolio strategies
* Analyze and interpret results of reports and models created to translate data into and create comprehensive, actionable solutions for our clients
* Effectively and accurately communicate analytical results and strategic implications within the context of a broader business setting
* Conduct general market research activities by gathering and synthesizing primary and secondary information to provide a broader understanding of the organization, our customers and business partners and the market dynamics in the industries we serve
* Extract, normalize and segment data from large datasets and databases (e.g., billing systems, sales data, depersonalized credit data, etc.) leveraging SQL and business intelligence tools
* Analyze revenue of customers and business segments to identify trends and/or market conditions impacting our business
* Evaluate market trends and expansion opportunities and translate analytical findings into insightful, succinct and compelling communications and business presentations
* Prepare financial analysis to support financial forecasting and investment business cases
* Complete ad-hoc analysis and benchmarking on existing customer accounts and prepare reports for internal and external distribution
* Create financial, sales and operational reports for Financial Services management
* Help to cultivate an environment that promotes excellence, innovation, and a collegial spirit
* Perform multiple tasks simultaneously and deal with changing requirements and deadlines

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our

Be a part of our

title: Lead Business Analyst & PMO Lead (Data Analytics) - Vice President

Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the entire function. * Resolves occasionally complex and highly variable issues.
* Produces detailed analysis of issues where the best course of action is not evident from the information available, but actions must be recommended/taken.

* Oversees management of people, budget and planning, to include duties such as performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary action and terminations and may include budget approval.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

**Recommended**
**Qualifications:**

The Lead Business Analyst & PMO Lead (Data Analytics) – Vice President (VP / C13) is a dual-capability leadership role combining senior program management (PMO), deep business analysis, strategic stakeholder communication, and advanced data analytics expertise.
  
  
This role serves as the central operational engine and strategic bridge between business executives, Markets Line of Business (LoB), Finance, Technology, Risk & Control (R&C), and Internal Audit (IA). Executive-Level Stakeholder Management: Serve as the strategic communication partner to senior leadership across Front/Middle Office, Product Engineering, Operations, and Quantitative teams.

title: Fraud Business Analyst
description:
Business Analyst – Fraud Risk Management (Banking & Financial Services)
  
  
**Location:**
Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Experience:**
4-12 Years
  
  
**Notice Period**
: Immediate to 60 days
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with expertise in Fraud Risk Management within the Banking and Financial Services domain. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, and operations teams to define requirements, analyze fraud risks, enhance anti-fraud solutions, and drive end-to-end project delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Gather business and functional requirements and prepare BRD, FRD, and FSD documents.
* Perform Business Analysis, Impact Analysis, Gap Analysis, and System Analysis for projects and enhancement initiatives.
* Manage end-to-end delivery of assigned projects/workstreams.
* Collaborate with Development, QA, and Business teams throughout the SDLC lifecycle.

* Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across business and technology teams.

* Good understanding of fraud typologies, fraud prevention, and mitigation techniques.

* Proficiency in SQL and MS Excel.

* Ability to perform under pressure and meet project deadlines.

* SDLC and Agile Business Analysis experience.
* Banking/Financial Services domain experience.
* Fraud Risk Management expertise.

title: Lead Analytics Product & Delivery Manager - Senior Vice President
description:
We are seeking an experienced
**SVP, Lead Analytics Product & Delivery Manager**
to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of People Insights and Organizational Effectiveness products and platforms.
  
  
This leader will oversee a portfolio of analytics, reporting, decision-support, and AI-enabled products that support workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee experience, and executive decision-making.
  
  
The role requires a combination of product leadership, strategic thinking, analytical problem solving, stakeholder management, and AI product expertise. The successful candidate will lead a team of product managers while partnering across Data Science, Data Engineering, Technology, HR, and Control Functions to bring innovative and governed solutions from concept through enterprise adoption.
  
  
The ideal candidate can connect long-term product strategy with day-to-day execution, ensuring solutions deliver measurable business value while operating within Citi's governance, privacy, and control frameworks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership**

* Define and own the product strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for People Insights and Organizational Effectiveness products.
* Develop and maintain a prioritized portfolio of analytics, reporting, workforce intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Identify opportunities where data, analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI can improve workforce decisions and organizational effectiveness.
* Evaluate initiatives based on business value, feasibility, regulatory requirements, adoption potential, and strategic alignment.
* Establish product investment priorities and recommend resource allocation across initiatives.
* Drive alignment between business priorities, product strategy, technology investments, and delivery roadmaps.

**Product Delivery and Execution**

* Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of analytics and AI products, from opportunity assessment and discovery through deployment and adoption.
* Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Technology teams to ensure solutions meet scalability, reliability, security, and usability requirements.
* Establish product delivery standards, governance processes, and success measures across the portfolio.
* Ensure that products are supported by clear business requirements, use cases, KPIs, and adoption plans.
* Monitor product performance and business outcomes, making data-driven decisions regarding future enhancements and investments.
* Drive continuous improvement across product development and delivery practices.

**AI and Analytics Product Innovation**

* Lead the identification and development of AI-enabled product opportunities across People Insights and Organizational Effectiveness.
* Partner with Data Science teams to incorporate predictive analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, agentic workflows, and decision-support capabilities into products where appropriate.
* Guide build-versus-buy decisions for AI capabilities, platforms, and vendor solutions.
* Establish frameworks for measuring product effectiveness, business impact, user engagement, and AI performance.
* Promote responsible AI adoption while balancing innovation, control requirements, and business outcomes.
* Stay current on emerging trends in AI, workforce technology, analytics platforms, and digital product innovation.

**Stakeholder and Executive Leadership**

* Build strong relationships with senior leaders across HR, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and the businesses.
* Translate complex workforce and organizational challenges into actionable product strategies and delivery plans.
* Serve as the primary product partner for senior stakeholders seeking to leverage analytics and AI to solve business problems.
* Present product strategies, investment recommendations, portfolio updates, and business outcomes to executive audiences.
* Influence decisions across teams without direct authority and build alignment among diverse stakeholder groups.
* Drive product adoption through effective stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and change-management efforts.

**Team Leadership and Talent Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of product managers responsible for analytics and AI-enabled products.
* Establish clear goals, accountability, and development plans for team members.
* Build product management capabilities across discovery, roadmap development, prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and product execution.
* Foster a culture of innovation, customer focus, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Promote best practices in product management, Agile delivery, experimentation, measurement, and user-centered design.

Governance, Risk, and Controls
  
  

* Ensure products comply with Citi's model risk, privacy, data governance, cybersecurity, and responsible AI standards.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Model Risk Management, and Technology teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Ensure appropriate controls, monitoring, documentation, and governance processes are established prior to deployment.
* Maintain oversight of product risks, dependencies, regulatory considerations, and control requirements across the portfolio.

**Required Qualifications**
**Leadership & Product Experience**

* 10+ years of experience across product management, analytics, technology strategy, consulting, or related disciplines.
* Significant experience leading product teams and managing complex product portfolios within a large enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated success owning product strategy, roadmap development, and delivery of enterprise-scale solutions.
* Proven ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across business, technology, and control organizations.
* Experience leading large cross-functional initiatives with measurable business outcomes.

**Analytics & AI Expertise**

* Strong understanding of analytics, data science, machine learning, and AI product development.
* Experience delivering analytics, data, or AI-enabled products from concept through deployment and adoption.
* Familiarity with Generative AI, Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, AI agents, and emerging AI technologies.
* Understanding of data engineering concepts, data platforms, APIs, enterprise architecture, and modern analytics ecosystems.
* Ability to evaluate technical approaches and translate business requirements into scalable product solutions.

**Business And Problem-Solving Skills**

* Ability to break down complex and ambiguous challenges into practical, actionable solutions.
* Strong executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
* Experience developing business cases, investment recommendations, and executive-ready decision materials.

* Experience with workforce analytics, workforce planning, talent strategy, organizational effectiveness, or HR technology.

title: Junior Data Engineering Analyst
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Junior Data Engineer to join the Data Engineering team supporting Logitech's global supply chain functions — planning, logistics, sourcing, manufacturing, procurement, and customer service. You will build and maintain data pipelines, models, and internal tooling that power operational and analytical decision-making across these domains.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain ELT/ETL pipelines on Snowflake using SQL, Snowpark (Python), and related tooling
* Build and optimize data models in the enterprise data warehouse (EDW) supporting supply chain reporting and analytics
* Develop and support Streamlit-in-Snowflake applications for internal business teams
* Write clean, well-tested SQL for data transformations, aggregations, and quality checks
* Collaborate with supply chain analysts and business users to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot data quality issues, and implement automated alerting
* Participate in code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing within the team

**Required Skills**

* 1+ years hands-on experience with SQL (complex queries, window functions, CTEs)
* Working knowledge of Python (data manipulation with pandas or similar)
* Familiarity with at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred; BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks acceptable)
* Understanding of data warehousing concepts — star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, incremental loads
* Basic understanding of version control (Git)
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to data accuracy

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with Snowflake features — stages, streams, tasks, dynamic tables, Snowpark
* Exposure to Streamlit or similar Python-based app frameworks
* Familiarity with orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt, or Snowflake Tasks)
* Domain exposure to supply chain processes (order management, logistics, serialization, inventory)
* Understanding of data governance and access control patterns

What You'll Learn & Grow Into
  
  

* Deep expertise in Snowflake's modern data platform (Snowpark, Cortex AI functions, native apps)
* Supply chain domain knowledge (planning, logistics, manufacturing, procurement)
* End-to-end ownership of data products — from ingestion to self-service applications
* Collaboration with global cross-functional teams

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* 1–2 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related data role
* Strong communication skills — ability to work with both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.
  
  
Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!
  
  
We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.
  
  
If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at +1-510-713-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Liquidity Risk Reporting - Analyst
description:
Join Barclays as Liquidity Risk Reporting – Analyst where the role holder will support wider team with the completion of their reporting and control activities, assisting them with the investigation and resolution of more complex issues. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.
  
  
**To Be Successful In This Role, You Should Have**

* Must have good communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively with the Reporting teams across the different locations.
* Good presentation skills.
* Very good Microsoft Excel skills.
* Understanding of Balance Sheet and Finance processes.
* Understanding of Control and Governance frameworks.
* CA/CWA/CS/MBA/Finance/Commerce/Economics background.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Experience supporting the roll out of controls frameworks.
* Understanding of Treasury and/or Risk systems in Barclays.
* Reporting work experience in a Bank / Financial Institution.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Chennai / Noida office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To verify that the bank has sufficient funds to meet its short-term and long-term obligations, and the development and implementation of strategies to manage the bank's liquidity position.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of funding and liquidity strategies to efficiently manage the bank’s liquidity position within regulatory requirements and risk appetite at favourable commercial outcomes with respect to funding costs.
* Analysis and quantification of the regulatory and behavioural liquidity risk impact of transactions undertaken by business units.
* Maintenance of strong relationships with key business units and working with the business units to manage liquidity to within constrains.
* Monitoring of key liquidity metrics and trends and advising on actions to be taken to maintain funding and liquidity levels within tolerance.
* Managing intra-group funding arrangements to ensure subsidiaries are adequately funded and managed within balance sheet, large exposure and capital constraints.
* Design and implementation of stress testing methodologies to assess the bank's liquidity resilience under various financial shocks, economic downturns, and sector-specific crises, and analysis of stress testing results and development of mitigation strategies to address potential liquidity shortfalls.
* Development of new tools, models and data analysis to support and enhance the bank’s funding and liquidity management capabilities.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: RA PAR and Controller Lead
description:
**Where do you fit in?**
Shell Downstream is undergoing a period of significant transformation as it evolves to deliver resilient cash flow while supporting Shell’s broader transition strategy. Growth and value creation are driven through portfolio optimisation, digitalisation, and the development of new customer-centric and lower‑carbon business models. This evolution is enabled through organic performance improvement, strategic partnerships, and selective acquisitions, positioning Downstream as a critical platform for delivering competitive returns today while progressively decarbonising products, services, and operations.
  
  
If you would like to be a part of this transition journey and you have a strong reporting & accounting, process and PAR background and are known for your enthusiasm and ability to work effectively across interfaces and bring people together to drive a common agenda with an end-to-end R&A accountability, then R&A PAR and Controller Lead is a role for you. Additionally, this role will give you opportunity to leverage your leadership capabilities and further grow as a finance professional.
  
  
**What’s the role?**
This new role has been created to lead team that supports the Downstream Business, being accountable for all R&A processes for entities and businesses in scope.
  
  
This role reports to the R&A DS PAR Manager and leads a team of financial professionals who are accountable for the timely, complete and accurate submission of Group Financial Returns & Local Statutory for the DS Portfolio, as well as for planning, forecasting and Planning and Appraisal processes for these businesses. Key interfaces will include business Finance Managers and business Leaders in DS, VP Finance, Performance Manager/Controller, PAR Advisors DS, Group Reporting, R&A Process Owner and Process Excellence organisations and R&A DS Community.
  
  

* Lead a team finance professionals of up to 10 finance professionals, providing e2e R&A support, i.e. Controlling, Accounting and Reporting, including MI, with first-time-right reporting and providing quality insights for the assets in scope.
* Represent FO R&A to the Business Finance leaders and act as an interface point for DS LT and Business leaders as required
* Own the Monthly, Quarterly and Annual Reporting processes for the business in scope
* Own and resolve reporting issues providing steers to stakeholders on financial queries
* Own and ensure efficiency of R&A process as well as effectiveness of underlying financial control framework in the area of responsibility
* Support the preparation of the annual Business Plan and related assessments to ensure a sound submission including operational, economic and financial KPIs
* Ensure delivery of the quarterly latest estimates process for the business in scope
* Ensure that performance is well analyzed and explained in the periodic management information packs (delivery through team)
* Deepen insightful analysis which incorporates external perspective, to support decision-making and drive the performance improvement agenda
* Contribute to the preparation of performance overviews and appraisals
* Provide ad-hoc analysis as required for leadership teams, including insights on financials/results, and specific performance measures
* Develop productive relationships with key stakeholders, to deepen the team's understanding of underlying issues within the line of business
* Ensure data confidentiality, integrity and accuracy in line with Group standards
* Ensure full and quality support for internal audits and reviews (controls, financials, SIA and other); co-owning the end results and driving improvement and completing remediation actions
* Ensure effective team management, focussed on sustainable delivery and high team engagement
* Where relevant coach other team members in areas of expertise. Build team capability and expertise
* Support global initiatives and projects in the PAR and controllership space, including new systems implementation. Champion and lead continuous improvement initiatives.

**What do we need from you?**
To be successful in this role you need a proven ability to work effectively across organisational boundaries, bringing different views together, finding an aligned approach forward, manage a wide agenda and effectively deal with conflicting priorities.
  
  
Furthermore, you will have:
  
  

* An accounting qualification with 10 years or more experience in financial reporting
* University degree in a finance related discipline with preference for a professional qualification and/or certification like CIMA, MBA, etc.)
* Experience of working in a highly dynamic, or start- up environment, dealing with ambiguity and managing change, providing direction and structure.
* Strong business partnering and stakeholder management skills with an ability to: influence; overcome barriers and resistance; communicate effectively at all levels in the organization and to work towards joint ownership towards a common goal.
* Experience with leading teams and/or project teams, effectively assigning and coordinating the work across various team members to drive towards a successful outcome
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills
* Strong delivery focus
* Excellent people management skills
* Strong understanding of financial and management reporting combined with the ability to easily identify value drivers and appropriate performance metrics
* Ability to effectively leverage a matrix organisation (FO/CoE/Business) with a focus on partnering and successful delivery
* Ability to work under pressure, with short deadlines and quick turnaround and still maintain an immaculate attention to detail

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**An Inclusive & Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.

**Shell in India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
  
  
Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
  
  
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

description:
**Job Description**
Ocean Export Pricing & Booking Management
  
  

* Develop and execute booking strategies aligned with volume, capacity, customer and profitability objectives.
* Ensure clear visibility of bookings, carrier allocation, capacity utilization and pricing commitments.
* Optimize carrier mix with focus on core carriers including Hapag-Lloyd, CMA CGM, MSC, COSCO and Maersk.
* Maintain spot business within defined thresholds and drive greater utilization of core carrier contracts.
* Monitor booking performance and proactively address capacity, rate and allocation gaps.
* Ensure timely and accurate updation of pricing, booking and performance trackers.

Carrier & Rate Management
  
  

* Manage commercial relationships with shipping lines and support negotiation of competitive ocean freight rates.
* Track market movements, carrier rate changes, GRIs/PSS and other relevant pricing developments.
* Provide regular market intelligence and pricing updates to Sales and network offices.
* Identify opportunities to optimize carrier selection and improve overall buying efficiency.
* Ensure pricing decisions balance competitiveness, volume growth and profitability.

Sales & Commercial Support
  
  

* Partner with Sales, network offices and sector teams to support new business acquisition and existing account growth.
* Develop pricing strategies for own accounts, new opportunities and special products.
* Support sales promotions across network offices, sectors and target customer segments.
* Provide timely and competitive quotations to improve business conversion.
* Maintain accurate quote logs and track business wins, losses and conversion trends.

Trade Lane Development
  
  

* Identify opportunities to develop and expand priority ocean export trade lanes.
* Analyse market trends, customer demand, carrier capacity and competitive pricing to identify growth opportunities.
* Develop strategies for new and special products and support their commercial penetration.
* Drive year-on-year growth across identified target trade lanes.

Volume & Profitability Management
  
  

* Drive FCL volume growth through effective pricing, carrier strategy and commercial support.
* Monitor contribution and EBITA performance across trade lanes, customers and carrier portfolios.
* Identify opportunities to improve yields, reduce cost leakage and enhance profitability.
* Work with Sales and Operations to improve conversion and profitable volume acquisition.

Performance & MIS Management
  
  

* Maintain accurate and timely monthly pricing and performance sheets.
* Ensure regular updates of quote logs, booking trackers, carrier allocation and market intelligence.
* Monitor business win percentage, FCL volumes, carrier mix and profitability against targets.
* Prepare periodic performance analysis and highlight key trends, gaps and corrective actions to management.

Branch & Product Maturity
  
  

* Work with target branches to improve ocean export pricing capability and product maturity.
* Provide guidance to branches on market rates, carrier strategies, trade lanes and pricing practices.
* Drive adoption of standard pricing processes and commercial best practices across eligible branches.
* Support branches in improving pricing discipline, customer conversion and profitable volume growth.

title: Lead Analyst, Algorithm Development Engineering
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and optimize image processing and computer vision algorithms for semiconductor inspection applications.
* Evaluate and productize machine learning and deep learning approaches where they provide measurable value.
* Prototype new concepts using Python and other analytical tools, and implement production-quality solutions in C++.
* Drive feature development from requirements definition through implementation, validation, release, and customer deployment.
* Perform root-cause analysis for field issues and develop robust corrective actions.
* Document algorithm design, experimental results, and technical recommendations.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Strong knowledge of:

+ Image Processing
+ Computer Vision
+ Machine and Deep Learning fundamentals
+ Statistics and Data Analysis
+ Pattern Recognition
+ Optimization techniques

* Proficiency in:

+ C++
+ Python
+ Linux development environments

* Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently on technically challenging assignments.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - Healthcare Analytics and Model Validation - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – Healthcare Analytics & Model Validation, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class Actuarial and Analytics services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Manager to join our Actuarial and Analytics team delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform healthcare analytics, predictive modeling, model governance and help organizations make better business decisions through data driven insights. The role will focus on independent model validation, healthcare analytics, and model risk management activities across financial, operational, predictive, forecasting, and AI/ML models. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements.
  
  
Within our growing team, members work alongside healthcare, actuarial, data science, and business stakeholders to assess model methodologies, assumptions, data quality, performance, documentation, and governance frameworks. The role offers an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to advanced analytical techniques, healthcare economics, predictive modeling, and emerging AI/ML applications while contributing to critical business decisions.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals comes from diverse backgrounds and is committed to being trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager in Actuarial and Analytics team, your role involves developing, implementing and reviewing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
On engagements, you will:
  
  

* Be responsible for providing high-quality results and generating effective solutions, working along with Senior Consultants, Managers, Senior Managers and Engagement Partners in delivering the project.
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members.
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagements are delivered within the designated time.
* Deliver engagements in line with EY values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards.
* Set and oversee team priorities, drive communication of project progress and risks, and monitor margins to ensure efficient resource utilization and delivery performance.
* Collaborate effectively with client teams, data scientists, business users, and other EY professionals.

Within the actuarial and analytics practice you will:
  
  

* Validate and review healthcare cost forecasting and claims prediction models.
* Review claims cost and utilization forecasting methodologies.
* Assess budget planning and financial forecasting models.
* Evaluate reimbursement optimization and revenue cycle analytics models.
* Review Fraud, Waste and Abuse (FWA) detection models and analytical frameworks.
* Support validation of AI/ML models used in healthcare decision-making.
* Review analysis performed on large healthcare datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and model performance issues.
* Perform ad hoc analytical projects and research activities.
* Stay informed of current developments in healthcare analytics, predictive modeling, AI/ML, and model governance.
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/geography.
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require analytical rigor, intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving abilities, the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, having a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS Actuarial and Analytics team.
  
  
We are looking for professionals who:
  
  

* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
* Excellent leadership skills to manage the engagement and ensure smooth delivery.
* Can independently investigate and challenge model assumptions.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Thrive in collaborative and client-facing environments.
* Are passionate about continuous learning and innovation.
* Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality standards.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 7+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, predictive modelling, model validation, actuarial analytics, risk analytics, data science, or related quantitative fields.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Strong understanding of statistical, forecasting, predictive modelling, and machine learning techniques.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, Power Query, advanced formulas, data modelling, data validation, and VBA/macros.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills.
* Ability to interpret complex quantitative results and communicate findings effectively.
* Experience of team management and project delivery.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience in US healthcare, health insurance, or managed care organizations.
* Exposure to healthcare claims analytics, medical cost forecasting, utilization management, or provider analytics.
* Experience reviewing AI/ML models and predictive analytics solutions.
* Familiarity with Model Risk Management (MRM) frameworks and model governance standards.
* Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, commercial health insurance, and provider reimbursement processes.
* Experience in presenting analytical findings and validation conclusions to senior stakeholders.
* Exposure to cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Experience using Python and/or SAS for analytics, model development, or validation activities.
* Experience performing data quality reviews and quantitative testing.
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Strong knowledge of healthcare analytics, predictive modeling, data science, and model validation practices.
  
  
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent healthcare analytics experience in leading engagement with recognized health insurers and healthcare service providers.
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate Manager, GBS CPM
description:
**Overview**
**Job Summary**

* Actively managing the Bank’s credit portfolio to maximise risk-adjusted returns for sustainable Group RoTE outcomes through better origination discipline, portfolio optimisation, modelling, early identification and action of stressed assets and distribution. Driving balance sheet optimisation and resilience through improving the inter-operability of key subsidiaries, reducing Cost of Funds (CoF) and improving quality and resilience of liabilities by monetising illiquid CIB loans to create medium term secured and contingent funding options that could even be used to raise funds in stress.

**Credit & Portfolio Management (CPM)**
**Analytics**

* We do CPM Analytics activities which involve RWA Variance analysis, Account Plan Tracking, CPM MI packs and OBL MI packs. CPM Distribution co-ordinates loan sales in the secondary market to generate liquidity, obtain RWA relief, and offload risk at minimum cost under the guidance of the Origination and Distribution Policy. To facilitate loan sales and other CPM Distribution initiatives, GBS CPM Team extracts the data on all transferable loans from multiple sources and compiles them in the Loan Database.

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal,

**Shell India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.

Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector.
