title: Senior Data Architect
description:
Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Data Architect with 14+ years of experience to serve as the design authority for enterprise data platforms. The role owns architecture and data-design decisions, enterprise data models, ERDs, modelling standards, and design governance across Microsoft Fabric and the broader data ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

· Own enterprise data architecture and end-to-end data-design decisions across source, integration, storage, modelling, semantic, and reporting layers.

· Develop and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models and current-state and target-state ERDs.

· Define entities, attributes, primary and foreign keys, relationships, cardinality, optionality, grain, and integration boundaries.

· Establish and govern enterprise data-modelling standards, naming conventions, reusable patterns, documentation templates, and model version-control practices.

· Lead design reviews, approve data models, document architecture decisions, manage design exceptions, and resolve cross-domain modelling conflicts.

· Design relational and dimensional models, including facts, dimensions, conformed dimensions, bridge tables, factless facts, surrogate keys, and aggregation strategies.

· Define standards for normalization, denormalization, Slowly Changing Dimensions, effective dating, late-arriving data, historization, soft deletes, audit columns, and lineage.

· Define Microsoft Fabric architecture across OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Notebooks, Dataflows Gen2, Semantic Models, Direct Lake, and Power BI.

· Ensure data solutions are scalable, secure, reusable, performant, testable, supportable, and aligned with governance and data-quality requirements.

· Translate business requirements into architecture and data designs and provide technical direction to data engineers, BI developers, analysts, and delivery teams.

At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms — it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts.

Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption.

* Support system integration activities, including hardware selection, software installation, and connectivity with PLCs, DCS, and historians.
* Collaborate with project managers and customer teams to ensure APC projects are delivered on schedule and to specification.
* Provide training and technical mentoring to APC engineers on data analytics and AI/ML applications within the ECS/ProcessExpert® platform.
* Evaluate emerging developments in advanced analytics and non-linear modelling to continuously improve APC applications.
* Contribute across the broader APC lifecycle, including sales support, product development, feature testing, and service support as required.

**''**
**What You Bring**

* Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Process Control, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applied to industrial processes.
* Proven experience in data mining, statistical modelling, model deployment, and real-time implementation.
* Background in process manufacturing industries; cement and minerals process knowledge is a strong advantage.
* Solid understanding of process optimisation, control strategy development, and benefit analysis.
* Experience with industrial data connectivity and historians, including SQL, MQTT, PLCs, DCS, and modern data platforms.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and data analytics tools commonly used in process industries, including: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Databricks

Willingness to travel (40–60%) within India and internationally for commissioning, pilot testing, customer engagement, and training.

PG preferred: MBA, MA Economics, Public Policy, International Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Management, Data Analytics, or an equivalent qualification.

title: Product & Material Data Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
Ascend Performance Materials is seeking a detail-oriented
**Product & Material Data Specialist**
to manage, structure, and maintain high-quality technical product and material master data across our global enterprise systems.
  
  
In this hands-on
**Individual Contributor**
role, you will work directly with engineering, technical, and supply chain teams to interpret engineering documentation, OEM catalogs, and technical datasheets. You will ensure that our material property databases, product catalogs, and specifications remain accurate, standardized, and governance-compliant.

+ Cleanse, standardize, and enrich technical product and material master data using standardized taxonomies and attribute schemas.
+ Review, extract, and validate technical parameters from engineering drawings, OEM catalogs, material datasheets, manuals, and specification sheets.
+ Verify component specifications, manufacturer/vendor part numbers, and technical attributes to enhance searchability and eliminate duplicate entries.

* Engineering & Cross-Functional Collaboration

+ Work directly with engineering, technical, procurement, and supply chain teams to align material master data with real-world technical requirements.
+ Support Bill of Materials (BOM) validation and ensure consistency between engineering specifications and ERP/data platforms.
+ Manage product documentation and digital technical assets, ensuring accurate enrichment with structured metadata.

* Data Quality & Governance

+ Execute data quality reviews, profiling datasets to identify inconsistencies, attribute errors, or missing technical specifications.
+ Perform duplicate resolution and implement data quality checks to ensure data accuracy across global manufacturing and shared service operations.
+ Adhere to corporate master data governance policies, standard operating procedures, and naming conventions.

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Polymer/Plastics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience: 7+ years of experience in Engineering Product Data Management, Technical Material Cataloging, or Industrial Product Data Management.
* Domain Knowledge:

+ Hands-on experience working with technical datasheets, OEM specifications, material test properties, or engineering drawings.
+ Exposure to manufacturing, industrial materials, polymers, chemicals, or MRO components.

title: Downstream Process Excellence Lead
description:
**Where you fit in**
If you like transforming and impacting the business and the process, with a passion for accounting, reporting and analysis and innovation, this could be your chance to make your mark in the energy industry. You will grow in a supportive team that champions process custodianship, improvement and transformation, projects and portfolio management and product ownership, in support of R&A’s aspiration of becoming an Accounting and Insights Powerhouse.
  
  

* The Downstream Reporting & Analysis (R&A) Organisation is a team of >900 colleagues providing accurate, timely and insightful finance and accounting and analysis to deliver more and cleaner energy solutions.
* Within the Downstream Reporting & Analysis is the Process Excellence Team which is responsible for leading and guarding the process, covering Planning and Appraisal (PAR), Finance Accounting and Controlling (FAC), and Period End (PE), for different Classes of Business (COB) (namely Mobility, Lubricants, Low Carbon Solution, Products and Chemicals).
* This role will report to the global Downstream Process Excellence Manager and is directly responsible for projects delivery, working closely through cross-horizontal collaboration and integration with the R&A Downstream Operations Teams – Controllers and PAR, Process Owners Team, MI Centre of Excellence (COE), Finance in the Business (FitB), Process Digital Interface and other teams within Shell.

**What’s the role?**

* The DS Process Excellence Lead is responsible for leading the delivery of Efficiency, Effectiveness, Finance Digital Core, and/or Governance portfolio of projects, leading various Operations Teams towards realizing efficiency opportunities and/or strengthening process effectiveness and governance.
* Manage initiatives, covering from ideation and opportunity building, demand management, design and build, implementation/delivery, go-live, to hyper-care:
* Specific projects and initiatives may fall and/or overlap within the functions of planning and appraisal, financial accounting and controlling, financial closing/period-end activities.
* Specific projects and initiatives may be standalone projects directly local to Downstream, or as part of a portfolio/program mandated by Group due to data, systems, and/or business changes (as in the case of growth investments and divestments).
* Specific projects and initiatives may lead and managed as part of the direct scope of Process Excellence, and/or as a portfolio/program managed in collaboration with R&A Operations Teams, MI COE, Finance in the Business, other PE teams within and beyond R&A, etc.
* Lead the change management, readiness (people, process, and/or systems, as applicable) and delivery reporting requirements of the projects and initiatives, to ensure optimal visibility, timely senior sponsorship and support, sufficient insights at decision review boards (DRB) as required, as well as appropriate resourcing and capabilities, among others, from ideation to hyper-care and stabilization.
* Lead the project requirements profiling, business and process impact assessments, and risk management assessments, and subsequently communicate such to proper levels of sponsorships and stakeholders.
* Identify and execute pivotal projects that enhance effectiveness and efficiency through collaborative efforts with PAR, and Solution (MI COE, IT, etc.) teams.
* Serve as the custodian of existing processes, seeking opportunities to optimize them with streamlined interfaces and structures while mitigating risks.
* Conduct comprehensive impact assessments of changes affecting the process, align with key stakeholders on potential impacts, and meticulously document the outcomes.
* Adhere to the Demand Management model in the acceptance and prioritization of new demands.
* Understand the implications of system transitions (CFIN, S4, NUCLEUS, etc.) on the R&A DS process, engage with Operations and Implementation teams at appropriate intervals, and ensure proper traction on key risks through collaborative efforts with all relevant stakeholders.
* Assess the prospective alterations to the PAR processes resulting from corporate reorganization, mergers, divestments, and integrations.
* Ensure the compliance to standard project management model in the execution and implementation of the key projects and initiatives.
* Exemplify leadership in driving transformative changes by leveraging robust Processes, People, and Systems.
* Augment the PE reputation by adhering to standardized procedures and ensuring effective communication with broader teams.
* Shall serve as pathfinder in data and knowledge management building specifically for value stream mappings, process documentation and socialization, among other knowledge management requirements.

**What we need from you?**

* You will inspire people to make changes that will have a direct impact on our success. Furthermore, you will have:
* Master’s degree or Professional Qualification, in Business/Accounting/Finance with exceptional numeracy skills and experience.
* Excellent project or program management skills and experience to Create Value.
* Change management expertise and experience in a multi-project or portfolio level.
* Excellent oral and written presentation skills.
* Appreciation and understanding of Downstream Financial and Management Information Systems and Data Flows, as well as a passion for leveraging technology and automation.
* Passion for the Downstream Business, the Energy Transition, Powering Progress, and a curiosity for how the business delivers value.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**An Inclusive & Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.

**Shell in India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
  
  
Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
  
  
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

title: Category Specialist, Indirect
description:
Category Specialist, Indirect Gradiant India Private Limited Chennai, India 10/28/26 Procurement
  
  
Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end-to-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, lithium and critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide.
  
  
Discover us at gradiant.com.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The
**Category Specialist – Indirect**
plays a key role in driving procurement excellence and optimizing indirect spend categories such as Travel, Facilities, IT, Professional Services, Insurance, Recruitment, and Laboratory Services. This role is focused on executing sourcing strategies, negotiating supplier agreements, optimizing
  
  
cost structures, and ensuring alignment with organizational objectives. Working closely with crossfunctional teams, the Category Specialist will support the development and implementation of category strategies, strengthen supplier partnerships, manage procurement processes, and deliver measurable business value through operational and strategic initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Category Strategy Alignment**

* Contribute to the formulation and execution of category strategies for indirect goods and services.
* Support the development of short-term and long-term objectives focused on cost optimization, supplier base efficiency, performance improvement, and service excellence.
* Monitor market conditions, supplier capabilities, and industry trends to ensure procurement strategies remain competitive and forward-looking.

**Supplier Relationship Management**

* Identify, evaluate, and qualify potential suppliers that align with organizational requirements and quality standards.
* Support the negotiation of supplier agreements, including commercial terms, service levels, and contractual conditions, to achieve optimal outcomes.
* Develop and maintain collaborative supplier relationships to ensure consistent performance, innovation, and risk mitigation.
* Participate in regular performance evaluations, supplier scorecard reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Strategic Sourcing and Procurement Execution**

* Execute sourcing projects for assigned categories, including preparing and managing RFPs, RFQs, tenders, and bid evaluations.
* Conduct supplier assessments and price benchmarking to identify opportunities for cost savings and value creation.
* Implement procurement best practices and ensure alignment with internal policies, governance requirements, and ethical sourcing standards.

**Cost Optimization and Value Delivery**

* Analyze spend data and procurement trends to identify cost reduction and process improvement opportunities.
* Support the implementation of cost-saving initiatives through supplier consolidation, negotiation, and alternative sourcing strategies.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure total cost of ownership (TCO) considerations are integrated into sourcing decisions.

**Risk Management and Compliance**

* Monitor and assess supply chain, financial, and operational risks associated with indirect categories.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of mitigation strategies to reduce business exposure and ensure supply continuity.
* Ensure supplier contracts, procurement activities, and sourcing decisions comply with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.

**Contract and Performance Management**

* Assist in drafting, reviewing, and managing supplier contracts to ensure compliance with terms, conditions, and performance expectations.
* Track contract performance, identify deviations, and work with stakeholders and suppliers to implement corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation to support audit, compliance, and performance reporting requirements.

**Data Analysis and Insights**

* Collect, consolidate, and analyze data related to category spend, supplier performance, and market dynamics.
* Prepare and deliver reports and dashboards to the Category Manager, highlighting performance metrics, cost savings, and improvement opportunities.
* Use data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making and continuous improvement efforts.

**Cross-functional Collaboration and Project Support**

* Partner with internal stakeholders across departments such as Finance, Legal, IT, and Operations to ensure category strategies are aligned with overall business objectives.
* Support and/or lead cross-functional project teams focused on procurement optimization, supplier development, and process enhancement initiatives.
* Contribute to organizational goals by fostering collaboration, transparency, and communication across functional areas.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Procurement, or a related discipline.
* Proficiency in SAP or similar procurement/ERP platforms.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence decision-making.
* Analytical mindset with a focus on data-driven insights and performance measurement.
* Strong organizational, time management, and project execution skills.
* Knowledge of risk assessment, mitigation strategies, and compliance frameworks.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective cross-functional collaboration.
* Problem-solving, critical thinking, and a continuous improvement mindset.
* 5–7 years of experience in procurement or strategic sourcing, preferably within indirect spend categories.
* Proven experience in supplier selection, negotiation, contract management, and category execution.
* Relevant professional certifications in Procurement, Supply Chain, or Strategic Sourcing are preferred.

Gradiant is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Customer-AM&C-Aprimo-Consultant Technical Transformation
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
Aprimo DAM & MRM Lead (Sr. Consultant)
  
  
**Experience Required: 3-6**
Years overall (minimum 3–4 years dedicated Aprimo
**DAM**
**and/or MRM**
experience)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Aprimo DAM & MRM Lead to own the strategic direction, architecture, and team leadership of our enterprise Aprimo Digital Asset Management
**and Marketing Resource Management**
platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Architecture & Governance**

* Own the long-term architectural roadmap for the Aprimo DAM and MRM platform - taxonomy evolution, metadata schema strategy, integration architecture, and AI capability adoption.
* Define and enforce enterprise-wide DAM and MRM governance standards: naming conventions, field design principles, classification ownership models, and change management processes.
* Review data models, taxonomies, and metadata structures within Aprimo MRM and DAM to ensure accurate reporting, data quality, and future extensibility.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders to translate complex marketing and compliance requirements into detailed Aprimo configuration blueprints and solution documents.
* Define governance guidelines for Aprimo configuration standards, naming conventions, and usage policies so that global teams follow consistent practices.

**🆕**
**MRM - Marketing Planning & Financial Management**

* Configure and manage Aprimo MRM's marketing planning and budgeting modules - including plan hierarchies, activity types, budget structures, and fiscal year setup aligned to enterprise marketing operating models.
* Design and maintain MRM financial workflows including budget request, approval, allocation, accrual, and reconciliation processes - ensuring finance and marketing teams operate from a single source of truth.
* Build and govern MRM project and activity templates that standardise how marketing programmes are initiated, tracked, and closed across global teams.
* Configure MRM work management capabilities - task management, project timelines, resource assignments, and capacity planning - to support marketing operations teams.
* Design MLR (Medical/Legal/Review) and compliance-driven approval workflows within Aprimo MRM for regulated industries, including routing rules, version locking, and audit trail requirements.
* Maintain and evolve MRM field design - custom fields, picklists, calculated fields, and conditional logic - ensuring that data captured at the plan and activity level supports downstream reporting needs.
* Define and enforce MRM data governance standards for plan naming conventions, cost centre mapping, vendor management, and invoice processing workflows.
* Configure and maintain MRM reporting and dashboard frameworks - including standard and custom reports across budget performance, activity status, resource utilisation, and campaign ROI.
* Manage MRM user role and permission architecture - defining role hierarchies, team structures, and access scoping aligned to organisational and regional team models.
* Support MRM integrations with finance and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday) for budget synchronisation, purchase order management, invoice reconciliation, and financial close processes.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a team of DAM Specialists, Analysts, MRM Administrators, and Integration Developers - setting technical direction and reviewing their configuration and integration work.
* Lead development teams by providing detailed interface specifications, mapping documents, and solution use cases that reduce implementation rework.
* Conduct code and configuration reviews for API integrations, ensuring adherence to security, performance, and maintainability standards.

**DAM Configuration & Taxonomy**

* Configure Aprimo DAM capabilities to streamline asset intake, metadata modeling, and governance processes that improve asset discoverability and reuse.
* Design and maintain a scalable, organisation-wide taxonomy (classification hierarchy) aligned to how marketing teams browse and search for assets.

**Integration Architecture**

* Own the end-to-end integration architecture connecting Aprimo to the broader MarTech and enterprise systems landscape (CMS, PIM, CRM, marketing automation, CDN).
* Design and build API-based integrations using the Aprimo REST API - including asset ingestion pipelines, metadata synchronisation, and event-driven workflows.
* Design and build MRM API integrations - including marketing plan data synchronisation, activity status feeds, budget and spend data pipelines, and bi-directional connectors with finance and ERP platforms.
* Implement OAuth 2.0 authentication flows, manage API client registrations, and maintain secure credential handling for all service accounts.
* Develop and maintain webhook configurations for event-driven integrations with downstream systems (CMS, PIM, email platforms, CDN).
* Build and maintain bulk asset ingestion pipelines handling multi-step processes: record creation, chunked file upload, metadata mapping, commit, and error handling.
* Implement and maintain the Aprimo Content Selector SDK within third-party applications - ensuring scoped authorisation, rendition control, and audit logging.

**Migration**

* Lead asset migration projects from legacy DAM systems or shared drives into Aprimo - including source audit, de-duplication, metadata mapping, and validation.
* Lead MRM data migration projects from legacy marketing planning tools, spreadsheets, or prior MRM platforms into Aprimo - including plan and activity data mapping, historical budget data migration, open workflow migration, and user acceptance validation.

**Aprimo certification is a plus.**
**Experience**

* 6–7 years total professional experience, including a minimum of 4–5 years of dedicated, hands-on Aprimo DAM and/or MRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience as the senior/lead technical resource on at least one full Aprimo implementation or major platform transformation - not merely a contributor.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring Aprimo MRM modules - including marketing planning, budget management, work management, and approval workflow design - at an enterprise scale.
* Proven ownership of enterprise taxonomy and metadata architecture decisions - able to speak to specific trade-offs made and their long-term consequences.
* Deep, verifiable hands-on expertise with the Aprimo REST API - must be able to design integration architecture from scratch, not just describe individual endpoint calls.
* Experience leading or mentoring a team of DAM analysts, specialists, MRM administrators, or developers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a regulated industry (pharmaceutical, financial services, healthcare) with MLR/compliance-driven workflow design - including MRM-side review routing and audit trail configuration.
* Experience owning a DAM or MRM platform migration at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with Aprimo Content Selector SDK, Agentic Orchestration (Copilot Studio, n8n, MCP Server), and emerging AI-driven DAM capabilities.
* Experience with enterprise identity/access architecture - SCIM provisioning, SSO integration, federated permission models.
* Experience integrating Aprimo MRM with ERP or finance platforms (SAP, Oracle, Workday) for budget and spend management.
* Familiarity with Aprimo MRM reporting frameworks and the ability to design custom dashboards for marketing operations and finance stakeholders. #Aprimo Referral Campaign

title: Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation - Aprimo
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
Aprimo DAM & MRM Lead (Sr. Consultant)
  
  
**Experience Required:**
6–7 Years overall (minimum 4–5 years dedicated Aprimo
**DAM**
**and/or MRM**
experience)

Full-Time
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Aprimo DAM & MRM Lead to own the strategic direction, architecture, and team leadership of our enterprise Aprimo Digital Asset Management
**and Marketing Resource Management**
platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Architecture & Governance**

* Own the long-term architectural roadmap for the Aprimo DAM and MRM platform - taxonomy evolution, metadata schema strategy, integration architecture, and AI capability adoption.
* Define and enforce enterprise-wide DAM and MRM governance standards: naming conventions, field design principles, classification ownership models, and change management processes.
* Review data models, taxonomies, and metadata structures within Aprimo MRM and DAM to ensure accurate reporting, data quality, and future extensibility.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders to translate complex marketing and compliance requirements into detailed Aprimo configuration blueprints and solution documents.
* Define governance guidelines for Aprimo configuration standards, naming conventions, and usage policies so that global teams follow consistent practices.

**🆕**
**MRM - Marketing Planning & Financial Management**

* Configure and manage Aprimo MRM's marketing planning and budgeting modules - including plan hierarchies, activity types, budget structures, and fiscal year setup aligned to enterprise marketing operating models.
* Design and maintain MRM financial workflows including budget request, approval, allocation, accrual, and reconciliation processes - ensuring finance and marketing teams operate from a single source of truth.
* Build and govern MRM project and activity templates that standardise how marketing programmes are initiated, tracked, and closed across global teams.
* Configure MRM work management capabilities - task management, project timelines, resource assignments, and capacity planning - to support marketing operations teams.
* Design MLR (Medical/Legal/Review) and compliance-driven approval workflows within Aprimo MRM for regulated industries, including routing rules, version locking, and audit trail requirements.
* Maintain and evolve MRM field design - custom fields, picklists, calculated fields, and conditional logic - ensuring that data captured at the plan and activity level supports downstream reporting needs.
* Define and enforce MRM data governance standards for plan naming conventions, cost centre mapping, vendor management, and invoice processing workflows.
* Configure and maintain MRM reporting and dashboard frameworks - including standard and custom reports across budget performance, activity status, resource utilisation, and campaign ROI.
* Manage MRM user role and permission architecture - defining role hierarchies, team structures, and access scoping aligned to organisational and regional team models.
* Support MRM integrations with finance and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday) for budget synchronisation, purchase order management, invoice reconciliation, and financial close processes.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a team of DAM Specialists, Analysts, MRM Administrators, and Integration Developers - setting technical direction and reviewing their configuration and integration work.
* Lead development teams by providing detailed interface specifications, mapping documents, and solution use cases that reduce implementation rework.
* Conduct code and configuration reviews for API integrations, ensuring adherence to security, performance, and maintainability standards.

**DAM Configuration & Taxonomy**

* Configure Aprimo DAM capabilities to streamline asset intake, metadata modeling, and governance processes that improve asset discoverability and reuse.
* Design and maintain a scalable, organisation-wide taxonomy (classification hierarchy) aligned to how marketing teams browse and search for assets.

**Integration Architecture**

* Own the end-to-end integration architecture connecting Aprimo to the broader MarTech and enterprise systems landscape (CMS, PIM, CRM, marketing automation, CDN).
* Design and build API-based integrations using the Aprimo REST API - including asset ingestion pipelines, metadata synchronisation, and event-driven workflows.
* Design and build MRM API integrations - including marketing plan data synchronisation, activity status feeds, budget and spend data pipelines, and bi-directional connectors with finance and ERP platforms.
* Implement OAuth 2.0 authentication flows, manage API client registrations, and maintain secure credential handling for all service accounts.
* Develop and maintain webhook configurations for event-driven integrations with downstream systems (CMS, PIM, email platforms, CDN).
* Build and maintain bulk asset ingestion pipelines handling multi-step processes: record creation, chunked file upload, metadata mapping, commit, and error handling.
* Implement and maintain the Aprimo Content Selector SDK within third-party applications - ensuring scoped authorisation, rendition control, and audit logging.

**Migration**

* Lead asset migration projects from legacy DAM systems or shared drives into Aprimo - including source audit, de-duplication, metadata mapping, and validation.
* Lead MRM data migration projects from legacy marketing planning tools, spreadsheets, or prior MRM platforms into Aprimo - including plan and activity data mapping, historical budget data migration, open workflow migration, and user acceptance validation.

**Aprimo certification is a plus.**
**Experience**

* 6–7 years total professional experience, including a minimum of 4–5 years of dedicated, hands-on Aprimo DAM and/or MRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience as the senior/lead technical resource on at least one full Aprimo implementation or major platform transformation - not merely a contributor.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring Aprimo MRM modules - including marketing planning, budget management, work management, and approval workflow design - at an enterprise scale.
* Proven ownership of enterprise taxonomy and metadata architecture decisions - able to speak to specific trade-offs made and their long-term consequences.
* Deep, verifiable hands-on expertise with the Aprimo REST API - must be able to design integration architecture from scratch, not just describe individual endpoint calls.
* Experience leading or mentoring a team of DAM analysts, specialists, MRM administrators, or developers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a regulated industry (pharmaceutical, financial services, healthcare) with MLR/compliance-driven workflow design - including MRM-side review routing and audit trail configuration.
* Experience owning a DAM or MRM platform migration at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with Aprimo Content Selector SDK, Agentic Orchestration (Copilot Studio, n8n, MCP Server), and emerging AI-driven DAM capabilities.
* Experience with enterprise identity/access architecture - SCIM provisioning, SSO integration, federated permission models.
* Experience integrating Aprimo MRM with ERP or finance platforms (SAP, Oracle, Workday) for budget and spend management.
* Familiarity with Aprimo MRM reporting frameworks and the ability to design custom dashboards for marketing operations and finance stakeholders. #Aprimo Referral Campaign

• Generate periodic reports on system performance, incident trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

**Experience**

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Role Summary**
The Business Analyst owns an AI or enterprise software engagement end to end: running the project day to day, writing the Business Requirement Document (BRD), and proving through functional testing that every BRD requirement works in the delivered system.
  
  
Detail Value Job title Business Analyst Department Delivery Reports to Chief Delivery Officer Experience 2–3 years in business analysis, with project coordination exposure Location onsite and hybrid
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Project management
* Plan scope, milestones and resourcing; maintain the project plan and RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies).
* Run sprint or phase ceremonies, weekly status reviews and steering updates with clients and internal teams.
* Track progress, budget and effort against plan; escalate slippage early with a recovery option.
* Manage change requests: assess impact on scope, timeline and cost, and secure sign-off before work starts.
* Business Requirement Document (BRD)
* Run stakeholder interviews, workshops and process walkthroughs to capture as-is and to-be processes.
* Write the BRD: business objectives, scope, functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, data needs and acceptance criteria.
* For AI features, define expected inputs, outputs, accuracy thresholds and human-review points.
* Keep a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) linking each requirement to design, build and test cases.
* Obtain formal BRD sign-off and control all later changes through versioning.
* Functional testing
* Write test scenarios and test cases from the BRD acceptance criteria.
* Execute functional, integration and regression tests; log, prioritize and retest defects to closure.
* Confirm through the RTM that every BRD requirement is present and working, with no gaps.
* Prepare and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business users, and issue the test summary report for go-live.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering and Masters of Business Administration.
* 2-3 years as a Business Analyst, including at least 1 years leading projects or workstreams.
* Proven track record writing BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and RTMs.
* Hands-on functional testing and UAT experience; familiarity with Jira.
* Working knowledge of Agile and Waterfall delivery; process modelling.
* Exposure to AI/ML, web and mobile application projects preferred.
* Clear written and spoken communication; confident facilitating client workshops.

**How Success Is Measured**
Measure Target BRD signed off Within the agreed discovery window Requirements traced and tested 100% of BRD requirements covered in the RTM Defects found after go-live No critical or high defects from missed requirements On-time, on-budget delivery Milestones met within the agreed tolerance UAT sign-off First cycle, with no open critical defects

title: Lead Consultant - S/4HANA Indirect Procurement IT Business Analyst
description:
**Role Title:**
Lead Consultant - S/4HANA Indirect Procurement IT Business Analyst
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, improved financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
The S/4HANA & Indirect Procurement IT Business Analyst plays a meaningful role in supporting the delivery and continuous improvement of AstraZeneca's global procurement platforms and processes. Working within the Procurement and Enterprise Technology organisation, the role supports the analysis, documentation, testing, deployment and optimization of solutions across SAP S/4HANA and associated non-SAP procurement applications.
  
  
The Business Analyst will partner with Product Managers, Product Experts, Enterprise Business Partners and business partners to understand business requirements, document functional needs, support process harmonisation and ensure solutions are aligned with AstraZeneca's global standards and fit-to-standard principles.
  
  
The role supports activities across the end-to-end Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration landscape, including SAP S/4HANA Procurement and Accounts Payable processes as well as key procurement applications such as Coupa, One Network, CyberGrants, IQVIA, Taulia, Workday and Concur.
  
  
The individual will contribute to solution testing, data migration activities, release management, deployment preparation and hypercare support while ensuring compliance with AstraZeneca quality and governance standards.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Gather, analyse and document business and functional requirements for procurement and supplier management capabilities.
* Support the design and continuous improvement of global Purchase-to-Pay processes.
* Collaborate with Product Experts and technical teams to translate business requirements into solution specifications.
* Support SAP S/4HANA Procurement and Accounts Payable process activities including requisitions, purchase orders, supplier collaboration, invoicing and payment processes.
* Support requirements and process analysis for non-SAP procurement systems including Coupa, CyberGrants, One Network, IQVIA and Taulia.
* Assist with data migration, master data creation and validation activities.
* Support system integration, user acceptance testing, regression testing and defect management activities.
* Participate in release planning, deployment activities and hypercare support.
* Work closely with business partners to find opportunities for process simplification, automation and standardisation.
* Support issue investigation and resolution across the procurement application landscape.
* Ensure solutions and documentation meet AstraZeneca compliance, validation and governance standards.
* Report progress, risks, issues and dependencies to project and product leadership teams.

**Essential For The Role**

* Experience as a Business Analyst supporting procurement, finance or supply chain processes
* Experience working with SAP Procurement, S/4HANA or ERP solutions
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements
* Understanding of Source-to-Pay and supplier management processes
* Experience supporting testing and deployment activities
* Strong partner management and communication skills
* Experience working within Agile delivery teams
* Knowledge of Source-to-Pay indirect procurement processes.
* Understanding of SAP S/4HANA Procurement and Accounts Payable concepts.
* Experience creating business & technical requirements and process documentation.
* Knowledge of testing methodologies and defect management.
* Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow or similar tools.
* Ability to analyse business data and process performance metrics.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Self-motivated and capable of handling multiple priorities.
* Effective communicator with both business and technical partners.
* Comfortable working in evolving and ambiguous environments.
* Good attention to detail and documentation quality.

**Desirable for the role**

* Knowledge of procurement integrations and supplier collaboration platforms.
* Understanding of API and middleware concepts.
* Exposure to SAP Business Network and SAP Fiori applications.
* Pharmaceutical industry experience
* SAP S/4HANA Procurement certification
* Experience supporting global transformation programmes
* Experience with MDG
* Experience with Non SAP systems
* Knowledge of Workday and Concur
* Experience in global, matrix organisations

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Fraud Risk Analyst is responsible for protecting customers and the bank by identifying, investigating, and resolving suspected fraud activity while minimizing financial losses and customer impact. This role reviews transactions, customer claims, account activity, and supporting documentation to make informed fraud decisions in accordance with established policies and procedures. The Fraud Agent performs customer authentication and verification, evaluates risk indicators, and takes appropriate action to prevent, mitigate, or resolve fraudulent activity. They maintain accurate case documentation, identify emerging fraud trends, and escalate potential risks or complex situations as needed. The role partners with customers, business partners, and internal support teams to deliver effective fraud resolutions while ensuring compliance with regulatory and operational requirements. Success in this position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer service in a fast-paced environment.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Investigate suspected fraud cases by gathering, validating, and documenting information from internal systems, customers, and third-party sources.
* Make timely decisions to approve, deny, escalate, or resolve fraud cases based on established procedures and risk criteria.
* Monitor accounts for suspicious activity and take appropriate action to prevent or minimize customer and bank losses.

Working under the guidance of senior technical leads, the developer focuses on implementing matching rules, maintaining data feeds, resolving technical breaks, and executing scheduled and ad-hoc reconciliation requests across financial systems and data distribution pipelines.
  
  
**Hybrid Schedule:**
2 or 3 full days per week on-site in the office, with remaining days worked remotely in accordance with enterprise hybrid work policies.
  
  
**Reconciliation Rule Build:**
Configure, test, and maintain multi-way matching rules, tolerance checks, and automated exception routing on enterprise reconciliation platforms (e.g., TLM SmartStream, Duco, Gresham, or internal reconciliation engines).
  
  
**Break Analysis & Triage:**
Investigate reconciliation breaks and discrepancies, identify root causes in data transformations, and apply rule adjustments or fixes.
  
  
**Data Processing & Scripting:**
Write and optimize Python scripts and SQL queries to extract, transform, and load transactional and ledger data into reconciliation engines.
  
  
**Requirements Implementation:**
Review Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and technical specifications to implement mapping rules, data schemas, and validation checks.
  
  
**Data Feed Maintenance**
: Monitor daily reconciliation runs, batch feeds, and automated jobs, ensuring successful data ingestion from upstream systems.
  
  
**Assisting Backlog Remediation:**
Actively deliver user stories and tasks to address the operational backlog of scheduled and ad-hoc reconciliation requests.
  
  
**Testing & Deployment Support:**

**Team Participation:**

Operational Collaboration: Work closely with operations users, business analysts, and quality assurance testers to clarify requirements and resolve defect tickets.

Learn and apply emerging tools and automation techniques, including data processing utilities (e.g., PySpark, Airflow) and automated anomaly detection workflows.

* Solid foundation as a technical individual contributor executing assigned tasks with quality.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C -AU - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: SENIOR CONSULTANT
description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
  
  
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
  
  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
  
  
**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role summary**
Migrate existing Lambda/Dagster/dbt pipelines onto a Glue‑based, Redshift‑centric medallion architecture (S3 Bronze → Redshift Silver → Gold canonical model), embed data quality, lineage, security and CI/CD controls into every pipeline, and mentor engineers through domain‑by‑domain migration waves
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
* Design and build Glue‑based ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
* Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
* Build automated data‑quality gates, reconciliation checks, and source‑to‑report lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of business‑critical reports
* Implement IAM, AWS‑native encryption, Secrets Manager and Gold‑layer RBAC/least‑privilege access.
* Establish Dev/Test environments, Git‑based CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
* Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
* Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
* Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

**Mandatory Skills**

* 10+ years in data engineering, 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
* Amazon Redshift (deep) data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
* AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and hands‑on medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
* AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
* Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
* Python (primary) — PySpark for Glue jobs.
* MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
* DBT— must be able to read, reverse‑engineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
* Data‑quality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
* Git, CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
* Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

**Nice to have**

* Dagster orchestration — for AS‑IS discovery and migration.
* Kafka / event‑driven streaming ingestion.
* Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
* Tableau, Metabase serving‑layer knowledge.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
* Data‑governance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).
* UK financial‑services experience IFRS 9, BCBS 239, FCA/PRA reporting, UK GDPR.
* Preparing governed datasets for AI/ML use cases.
