title: Supplier Capacity Planning Analyst
description:
The Supplier Capacity Planning Analyst is responsible for obtaining, validating, and analyzing supplier capacity information to determine whether the supply base can support current and future production requirements.
  
  
The role works closely with capacity planning, purchasing, supplier technical assistance, material planning and logistics, program teams, and regional constraint-management teams. The analyst will prepare capacity studies, identify supply risks, support production-planning activities, and coordinate actions to resolve supplier capacity shortfalls.
  
  
The position requires strong analytical, planning, supplier-management, and cross-functional communication skills.
  
  

* Collect and validate supplier capacity data and manufacturing-constraint information across assigned global markets.
* Analyze supplier production capacity against current operating plans, forecasted volumes, and new-program requirements.
* Prepare capacity studies in response to requests from regional vehicle-capacity planning teams.
* Identify supplier bottlenecks, capacity gaps, and manufacturing constraints that could affect production or program launches.
* Work with purchasing, supplier technical assistance, material planning and logistics, program teams, and suppliers to develop recovery or mitigation plans.
* Conduct short-term capacity studies to support monthly operating plans and changing production requirements.
* Support the monthly production-programming process by confirming that planned production volumes are supported by available supplier capacity.
* Prepare demand-versus-supply assessments for reported constraints.
* Develop commodity constraint summaries and supporting analyses using standard constraint-management methods and reporting formats.
* Communicate capacity-study requests, collaboration requirements, deadlines, and system notifications to suppliers.
* Follow up with suppliers to ensure capacity information is submitted accurately and by the required deadline.
* Maintain supplier capacity data in relevant planning and capacity-management systems.
* Escalate unresolved supplier capacity risks to the appropriate purchasing, planning, program, and supplier-management teams.
* Maintain accurate status reports and communicate risks, assumptions, decisions, and required actions to stakeholders.
* Identify and implement process improvements that improve data quality, study completion, supplier responsiveness, or planning efficiency.

**B.E / B. Tech (Mech, Auto, Prod)**
**Minimum 2**
**+ Years relevant experience in MP&L / SCM**
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related discipline.
* At least three years of relevant experience in supply chain management, material planning and logistics, supplier capacity planning, production planning, procurement, or manufacturing operations.
* Experience in production planning and control, procurement, or supplier management.
* Experience using ERP, MRP, inventory-management, or production-planning systems.
* Ability to analyze demand, production capacity, utilization, and manufacturing constraints.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders across different regions.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple studies, deadlines, and escalations.

**Preferred**

* Basics on LLM, Power BI for Process automations and Projects.
* Experience in the automotive or high-volume manufacturing industry.
* Experience conducting supplier capacity studies or production feasibility assessments.
* Understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling, cycle times, shift patterns, equipment utilization, and production bottlenecks.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookup functions, data validation, and capacity-analysis models.
* Experience with enterprise capacity-planning or supplier-management systems.
* Familiarity with constraint management, root-cause analysis, and capacity recovery planning.

Shift timings - 2.00 PM - 11.30 PM

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

title: SAP Analytics Cloud &Datasphere Platform and Ops Engineer
description:
**Main duties and responsibilities**

The role will be responsible for the following activities:

 Platform ownership: Lead the build and run of SAP Datasphere and SAC connectivity, data integration pipelines, and modelling standards.

 Architecture and design: Define integration patterns (live, federated, acquired), connectivity

topologies (Cloud Connector, SDI/SDQ), and performance optimization (pushdown, caching).

 Security and compliance: Govern SSO/SAML, trusted connections, roles/authorizations, and

data protection aligned to enterprise policies.

 Reliability and operations: Implement end-to-end monitoring, alerting, SLAs, runbooks, and

incident/problem management for connectors, agents, and data pipelines.

 Collaboration and leadership: Partner with SAP functional teams, data/analytics, network/security, and business stakeholders; mentor engineers and enforce standards.

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams, contributing to the solution design and integration

of SAC and Datasphere in end-to-end business processes.

**Essential requirements**

* Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics or a comparable degree.
* Overall, 8-10 years of experience and at least 2-3 years’ experience working on SAP SAC / Datasphere solutions as a platform engineer / platform owner or relevant role.
* Proven experience designing and implementing solutions utilizing SAC for planning,forecasting, and KPI reporting, as well as integrating with SAP Datasphere and upstream processes.
* Platform engineering and modelling: Lead Datasphere space/design modelling (semantic, fact/dimension, associations, hierarchies, measures) with strong performance optimization,cost control, and pipeline orchestration (federation, query pushdown).
* SAC solutions and usability: Deliver high-quality SAC stories, input templates, Analytics Designer apps, and guided workflows, emphasizing usability, governance, and performance; manage live/import models and secure refresh scheduling.
* Enterprise connectivity and security: Own live/acquired connectivity across S/4HANA, Datasphere, and non-SAP sources using Cloud Connector, Destination service, OData/JDBC, SDI/SDQ, remote tables; enforce SSO/SAML, trusted connections, RBAC, and compliance.
* Operations, monitoring, and resilience: Establish observability (health checks, alerts), error handling, auto-recovery, and SLA-driven operations; optimize performance via partitioning, caching, and connectivity tuning.
* Governance and quality assurance: Define standards, naming conventions, data lineage,Data products and catalogue/metadata; drive testing (strategy, UAT, performance), defect management, and produce architecture/design documentation, runbooks, and user guides.
* DevOps and lifecycle management: Manage environment promotion (dev/test/prod), transport/deployment tooling, dependencies, and release readiness; oversee incident, problem, and change management.
* Stakeholder engagement and troubleshooting: Translate senior stakeholder requirements, prioritize value, and drive adoption; perform root-cause analysis across network/security/SAP basis/Datasphere/SAC with strong communication and diagnostic skills.
* SAP Coordination: Manage SAP OSS notes, service requests, and vendor engagements; evaluate and roll out feature packs and roadmap items.
* FinOps and cost optimization: Implement cloud cost governance for Datasphere and SAC, including usage analytics, right‑sizing, tagging/chargeback, budget forecasting, and cost guardrails; drive performance-to-cost optimization.
* License management and entitlement governance: Administer SAC license allocations (BI, Planning) and Datasphere capacity; monitor active vs dormant users, reclaim and reassign entitlements, ensure compliance with contract terms, and report license utilization and optimization opportunities to leadership.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in an Agile environment.
* Energetic, organised and self-motivated.
* Fluent in business English.

title: AVP Barclaycard
description:
Join us as an AVP Barclaycard at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
To be successful in this role you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Post graduate qualification in a numerate/information discipline desirable.
* CA/ICWA,MBA (Finance) or any other graduation degree with a strong academic record.
* Experience in Financial Reporting, Regulatory reporting and Control, Planning and/or Analytics.
* Barclays data and/or analytics experience a distinct advantage.
* Experience around designing MI dashboards, analytics and insights.
* Knowledge in Business Intelligence platforms like SAP, Tableau, Alteryx, Python, data management, transformation.
* Project management /scrum master capabilities to drive prioritization.
* Experience around designing MI dashboards and insights.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Chennai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To develop and implement the bank's financial plans and stress testing methodologies by assessing the bank's resilience under various economic scenarios.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of stress testing methodologies and analysis of the results to identify potential vulnerabilities, assess capital adequacy, and inform risk mitigation strategies.
* Management of the bank's financial risks, including development and implementation of risk management strategies and communication of financial risks to relevant stakeholders.
* Analysis of the bank's capital position and assessment of its ability to meet regulatory capital requirements, development of capital management strategies to optimise capital utilisation and evaluation of the impact of capital allocation decisions on the bank's risk profile and financial performance.
* Orchestration of process cycles for the Planning and Stress Testing FTC and project managing delivery of the Planning Process and stress tests).
* Documentation of requirements prescribed by the Regulator, Process/Data Owner   .
* Tracking and reporting cycle progress via P&ST Steer Co, POC, Working Groups and the workflow tool.     .
* Management of data, dataflows and data quality from contributors - input through to report submission.    .
* Management of BAU systems to enable a quick outcome and iterative generation of Capital or Funding plans and separately drive process reengineering initiatives.    .
* Ownership of the control's environment, standards, conformance, partnering with BIA to ensure the FTC meets its controls and governance objectives.   .

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Fintech - FDI - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Supplier Management Specialist
description:
**Are you passionate about managing strategic supplier performance, contracts, and partnerships to improve quality, service, cost, and operational outcomes?**
**Would you enjoy using data, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement to manage risk and strengthen an end-to-end supply chain?**
**About The Team**
Print Supply Chain Management is responsible for printing/manufacturing books, demand forecasting, deciding where products should be produced, and distribution, warehousing, transportation, stocking, and print-on-demand fulfillment.
  
  
**About The Role**
The role requires driving the performance of strategic suppliers to deliver quality, service, cost, and value; build strong supplier partnerships that promote accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement; and collaborate across the Supply Chain to strengthen resilience, manage risk, and deliver end-to-end business outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Supplier Performance Management: Manage strategic supplier performance. Maintain scorecards, KPIs, reports, reviews, and meetings. Monitor contracts and SLAs. Address gaps through corrective actions. Improve service, quality, cost, and operations. Build strong relationships and maintain commercial governance.
* Contract Management: Manage supplier contracts throughout their lifecycle. Monitor obligations, pricing, and service commitments. Support renewals, amendments, and extensions. Maintain accessible records. Work with Procurement and Legal to clarify contract terms.
* Tender and Supplier Selection Support: Support sourcing and tender activities. Contribute to RFPs, RFIs, evaluations, and due diligence. Assist with supplier assessments, onboarding, and transitions. Define performance and service expectations.
* Financial and Commercial Management: Track supplier spend, volumes, and cost trends. Measure results against budgets and targets. Support invoice checks and payment resolution. Verify pricing and identify savings. Report spend, volume, and performance.
* Risk and Business Continuity: Work with Risk Management and Operations. Assess operational, financial, geopolitical, cybersecurity, sustainability, and compliance risks. Maintain risk registers and track mitigation actions. Support continuity plans, incident management, and reviews.
* Supplier Governance: Ensure compliance with company policies, regulations, sustainability commitments, and ethical standards. Support onboarding and ongoing governance. Review compliance records and certifications. Escalate issues appropriately.
* Data, Reporting, and Insights: Maintain supplier dashboards and reports. Analyse operational and commercial data. Identify trends and improvement opportunities. Report to key stakeholders. Support forecasting and capacity planning.
* Collaboration: Partner with Procurement, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, Planning, Risk Management, Legal, and other teams. Prevent silos and share expertise. Support cross-training, supplier transitions, business changes, and major projects. Promote an integrated, end-to-end supply chain.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrate a strong commitment to achieving goals. Monitor progress regularly, take responsibility for group outcomes, and encourage accountability and ownership. Recognise and share credit for contributions.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and provide coaching and mentoring to others. Explain complex technical matters clearly and adapt communication to suit the audience. Remain current within the discipline, build external connections, and apply best practices.
* Provide clear instructions and direction. Listen actively, ask effective questions, and consider different viewpoints. Explain the wider business context clearly.
* Manage unexpected situations independently and act with confidence. Remove obstacles and follow through on agreed actions. Encourage initiative by providing appropriate information, resources, and support while maintaining individual ownership of goals and achievements.
* Ask relevant questions and gather facts from multiple sources. Identify and analyse problems, recommend suitable solutions, and manage routine issues independently.
* Promote cooperation across the team. Remove barriers that affect team performance and support the effective resolution of conflicts.
* Identify opportunities for teams to collaborate. Seek input and expertise from team members, and encourage open, constructive discussion on matters affecting the team.
* Provide support without reducing individual ownership. Help individuals and teams achieve their objectives, and recognise shared contributions to successful outcomes.
* Shift Timings- 2pm-11pm

**Work in a way that works for you**
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.
  
  

* Working remotely from home up to 3 days a week and in our office in a hybrid style
* Working flexible hours - flexing the times you work in the day

**Working for you**
**Benefits**
We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
  
  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home -office - home (applies in Chennai)

**About The Business**
A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.
  
  
**We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: Data Migration QA
description:
**About the company**

Lexitas is a high growth company. The Company is built on a belief that having strong personal relationships with our clients, and providing reliable, accurate and professional services is the driving force of our success.

Lexitas offers an array of services including local and national court reporting, medical record retrieval, process service, registered agent services and legal talent outsourcing. Our reach is truly national as well as international.

Lexitas is a MNC Company that has set up a subsidiary in Chennai, India – Lexitas India Pvt. Ltd. This Indian company will be the Lexitas Global Capability Center, helping build a world class IT development team, and over time serve as a Shared Services hub for several of the corporate functions.

**For More Information -**
https://www.lexitaslegal.com

**This is a Full-Time Job located in Chennai, India.**

**Summary**

Lexitas is seeking a detail-oriented and technically strong Data Migration QA / Validation Engineer to ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data migration initiatives. This role will be responsible for validating migrated data, designing reconciliation and testing frameworks, and ensuring data readiness throughout the migration lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SQL, Python, MySQL, ETL testing, and data quality validations, with hands-on experience in verifying data accuracy, completeness, security, and consistency across source and target systems. The role involves developing automated validation scripts, performing pre- and post-migration testing, investigating data discrepancies, and collaborating closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, and ETL developers.

This position plays a critical role in delivering high-quality, reliable, and compliant data migration solutions while ensuring smooth deployment processes and maintaining data integrity across business systems.

**Essential Functions:**

* Will be responsible for quality in data migration. This includes accuracy, completeness, integrity and security of the transferred data.
* Will design validation strategies, build reconciliation scripts, and sign off on data migration readiness
* Strong testing experience for pre and post migration validations
* Write complex SQL queries, automated scripts (Python), or use data quality frameworks to verify data integrity.
* Test Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) workflows, data cleansing rules, and enrichment processes
* Build and maintain validation frameworks to ensure data quality and integrity
* Configure and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines)
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies and pipeline failures
* Identify, log, triage, and retest migration discrepancies, collaborating closely with data engineers and ETL developers
* Collaborate with BAs to understand data requirements and business rules

**Competencies, Skills and Abilities:**

* Advanced SQL for data profiling, queries, and reconciliation
* Strong experience in Mysql database and python as programming language
* Should be comfortable in Linux
* Should have experience of AWS deployment and S3 EC2
* Experience in bitbucket, branching models
* CI-CD experience with bitbucket/GIT pipeline
* Working experience with Jira
* Good to have - PHP Laravel
* Good to have - legal domain experience

description:
**About the company**

Facilio is the agentic platform transforming how large buildings run their physical operations. We’re building the AI-native operating layer for buildings, with a mission to make every building operationally efficient.

We’re a team of 170+ people with a growing presence across the US, UK, Middle East and Australia. We’re backed by leading global investors including Accel, Tiger Global, Dragoneer and Brookfield Growth.

**Role Description**

You'll work with prospective customers to understand their business problems, build tailored solutions using Facilio, and demonstrate how our product can solve real-world challenges.

* Requirement elicitation: Engage with customers to understand their business processes, uncover pain points, and ask the right questions to get to the root of a problem.
* Functional and solution design: Translate business requirements into workflows and functional solutions, exploring how Facilio can address customer needs.
* Build and deploy: Configure the product, work with data, test workflows, and build tailored demos and working solutions for customers.

You will be hands-on in developing autonomous AI agents, large language model (LLM) pipelines, and reinforcement learning engines that optimize customer lifecycles, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business value. **Position Summary**
**Job Description - Strategy & Transactions – Strategy (Sr. Consultant)**

**We work with C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high-stakes moments.**
**But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.**
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy , end-to-end M&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement & restructuring, to infrastructure & real estate advisory and sustainability-driven innovation.**
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy & Transactions is your next move.**
**The team**
Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate & Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy & Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
  
  
Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
  
  
**Work you will do:**
Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies. As a Technology Strategy Consultant with expertise in Data Strategy, you will:
  
  

* Provide strategic direction, understand business goals, and define how data can be leveraged to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and business growth for client organizations.
* Work closely with clients to solve strategic issues pertaining to Data, governance, architecture, and oversee the successful implementation, ensuring they align with the broader technology and business strategies.

**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (Data Strategy)**

* Candidates are required to have at least one full project experience on either one or more of the following areas of Data Strategy:
* Enterprise Data Management – Strong understanding of data management process across the data lifecycle (MDM, ingestion, storage, transformation) with experience in evaluating the client's data landscape and architecture to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Data Ambition & Value Realization – Having a long track record of delivering data / analytics / AI related change at an enterprise level in a particular industry or sector and helping shape a value creation story specific to the client competing in a particular market.
* Data Platform & Architecture Design – Knowledge of data and AI platforms and architecture frameworks
* Data Operating Model Design – Having a strong understanding of data and AI capabilities, and the ability to design operating model clearly defining roles, responsibilities, and RACI for the data organization.
* Data Governance Strategy – Assessing current data and AI governance practices and maturity within client organizations, having the ability to define and implement data governance strategies and frameworks for organizations.
* Strong understanding of data, analytics, and AI technology stack and infrastructure with exposure to new age technologies such as Generative AI.
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends including the associated technology and data implications within one or more industries.
* Demonstrate application of business acumen while leveraging data and analytics
* One life cycle project execution experience in recommending and/or implementing data strategy and solutions for improving business outcomes.
* Experience of being a data Product Owner and responsible for delivering product model and communicating the product needs with business partners.
* Exposure to working with non-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders.

**Core Consulting**

* Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.

**Description**
Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable dashboards, reporting systems, and automated data pipelines that support business reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR), pilot launches, and ongoing program governance.
* Own data infrastructure end-to-end—partner with tech, analytics, and operations teams to establish and maintain required tables, data lakes, and data structures that enable accurate and timely insights for APIE and related stakeholders.
* Retrieve, aggregate, and analyze data from multiple sources to produce actionable insights, KPI frameworks, and escalation deep dives that inform feature expansion, defect identification, and strategic decision-making.
* Develop and maintain SQL queries and analytical models to support APIE feature performance, ad-hoc requests, and dive-deep investigations for operational or customer/vendor escalations.
* Enable data-driven decision making by converting large datasets into digestible narratives, financial/CX estimates, and recommendations for pilots, experiments, and global expansions.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, build KPIs, automate processes, and drive data-aligned solutions that meet evolving business needs.
* Prepare and deliver business reviews and written narratives for senior leadership, highlighting progress, insights, risks, and decision points.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions, providing analytical input that shapes long-term product and operations strategy across global regions.

**About The Team**
About Amazon
  
  
Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Through continuous innovation in selection, convenience, and low prices, Amazon has grown from an online bookstore into a global e-commerce and technology leader. Our teams build solutions that improve how customers shop, how sellers grow, and how our global supply chain operates.

RBS strengthens Amazon’s retail engine by driving standardization, improving process quality, and reducing defects across global marketplaces. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon’s systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high-quality customer and selling-partner experience.

RBS International Emerging Stores (IES) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon’s per-unit economics across the emerging countries supply chain. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.

* 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

* Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field, or experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis
* Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

title: Business Analyst (Project Implementation)
description:
**About Facilio**

Facilio is the agentic platform transforming how large buildings run their physical operations. We’re building the AI-native operating layer for buildings, with a mission to make every building operationally efficient.

We’re a team of 170+ people with a growing presence across the US, UK, Middle East and Australia. We’re backed by leading global investors including Accel, Tiger Global, Dragoneer and Brookfield Growth.

**What you’ll do**

You'll work closely with enterprise customers to understand how their business operates and help them get the most out of Facilio. You will understand customer needs, translate them into practical solutions, and drive the functional side of implementation — using AI and automation to make delivery faster and more scalable.

* Lead customer discovery: Conduct workshops and discussions with customer stakeholders to understand their business processes, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes.
* Translate needs into solutions: Convert business requirements into clear functional requirements, workflows, and solution designs that align with Facilio's product capabilities.
* Make sound solutioning decisions: Understand what can be addressed through existing product capabilities, configuration, process changes, or product enhancements. Identify gaps and work with the right teams to resolve them.
* Drive functional implementation: Own the business analysis side of onboarding, from requirements and scope definition through functional validation, UAT, and go-live readiness.
* Use AI to accelerate delivery: Leverage AI tools to streamline documentation, requirement analysis, test-case creation, and other implementation activities, focusing your time on customer understanding, solution quality, and decision-making.
* Work across teams: Collaborate with Implementation, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to clarify requirements, address functional gaps, and keep customer implementations moving.
* Enable customer adoption: Help customers understand how to use Facilio to support their workflows, and facilitate training and knowledge transfer where needed.
* Improve how we implement: Identify recurring customer requirements and implementation challenges, and help build reusable workflows, documentation, and solution patterns that make future implementations more efficient.

**What we’re looking for**

* 1–3 years of experience in Business Analysis, SaaS implementation, solution consulting, or a similar customer-facing role.
* Strong business analysis skills: Able to understand business processes, ask probing questions, uncover underlying needs, and translate them into clear requirements.
* Customer-facing confidence: Comfortable conducting workshops, engaging with customer stakeholders, clarifying expectations, and communicating solutions clearly.
* Functional problem-solving: Able to connect business requirements with product capabilities, identify gaps, and think through practical solutions rather than simply documenting what the customer asks for.
* Product mindset: Understands the importance of balancing customer needs with product limitations, implementation effort, and scalable solutions.
* Structured execution: Comfortable with requirement documentation, workflow mapping, functional testing, UAT, and implementation coordination.
* AI-first mindset: Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to automate repetitive work, improve the quality of deliverables, and work more efficiently.
* Strong communication and collaboration: Able to work effectively with customers and cross-functional teams, including Product and Engineering.

**Life at Facilio**

At Facilio, we lead with a people-first culture. Flexible hours, self-managed leave, and wellness breaks support your work–life rhythm. Hierarchies are flat, leadership is approachable, and everyone’s voice carries weight.

**Here’s what drives how we work:**

* **High Performance**
  – We punch above our weight and hold a high bar—individually and as a team.
* **Ownership**
  – Everyone’s a builder. We operate with a “goal-over-process” mindset—less waiting, more doing.
* **Trust & Autonomy**
  – People are trusted with real responsibility. We believe in giving freedom, not instructions.
* **Collaboration**
  – Cross-functional by design. We solve together, celebrate together, and grow together.
* **Experimentation**
  – We run bold experiments, fail fast, and learn even faster.

****Job Description:****
**Role focus:**
Hands-on delivery across Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Snowflake, SQL, and AI-enabled business solutions.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The IT Analyst will design, develop, enhance, and support business applications, dashboards, reporting solutions, and workflow automations for the Visualization team. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Power Platform and Power BI, supported by solid Snowflake and SQL capabilities. The successful candidate will work directly with business partners and technical teams to translate requirements into secure, scalable, user-friendly, and data-driven solutions. The role will also contribute to practical AI-enabled capabilities that improve productivity, analytics, and business decision-making.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support Power Apps solutions, including Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps.
* Develop workflow automation and system integration using Power Automate.
* Build and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, scorecards, and operational analytics.
* Develop efficient DAX measures and Power Query transformations and optimize report performance and usability.
* Use Snowflake and SQL to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data for applications and visualization solutions.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, define solution options, and deliver fit-for-purpose outcomes.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams, APIs, Snowflake, and other approved enterprise data sources.
* Apply security, access control, row-level security, data privacy, governance, and application lifecycle management practices.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
* Create clear technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer and user support.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, Copilot, and automation to improve business processes and analytical experiences.
* Participate in Agile delivery, estimation, testing, release management, and continuous improvement activities.

Required Technical Competencies
  
  
Microsoft Power Platform
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with Power Apps, particularly Canvas Apps. Experience with Model-Driven Apps is desirable.
* Strong hands-on experience with Power Automate, including approvals, notifications, scheduled flows, and integrations.
* Working knowledge of Dataverse, solution packaging, environment management, connectors, and application lifecycle management.
* Ability to design intuitive user experiences and reusable application components.

Power BI and Visualization
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
* Proficiency in data modeling, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, drill-throughs, bookmarks, and report navigation.
* Experience performance optimization, refreshing troubleshooting, gateway concepts, and row-level security.
* Ability to apply visualization best practices and translate complex data into clear business insights.

Snowflake and SQL
  
  

* Strong SQL skills, including joins, subqueries, common table expressions, aggregations, views, and query optimization.
* Hands-on experience querying and validating data in Snowflake.
* Understanding relational data models, data warehousing, ETL/ELT concepts, data quality, and reconciliation.

AI and Emerging Technology
  
  

* Understanding generative AI concepts and practical enterprise use cases.
* Experience or strong exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Snowflake Cortex, AI Builder, or AI-enabled Power Platform capabilities.
* Ability to incorporate AI-assisted features into apps, automation, and analytics solutions where appropriate.
* Knowledge of prompt design, responsible AI, data security, privacy, and human validation of AI-generated outputs.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's or Masters`s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Approximately 5 -7 years of relevant experience in Power Platform, business intelligence, visualization, analytics, or application development.
* Demonstrated hands-on delivery experience in Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, SQL, and Snowflake.
* Experience gathering requirements and delivering solutions in collaboration with business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience supporting production applications, dashboards, and data solutions in an enterprise environment.

**Preferred Competencies**

* Experience with Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, REST APIs, SharePoint Online, or Teams integration.
* Exposure to Tableau or ThoughtSpot.
* Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable work management and CI/CD tool.
* Understanding testing practices, source control, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and support processes.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams and with global stakeholders.
* Experience in machine manufacturing or a related industrial domain is preferred.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Customer-focused approach with the ability to understand business needs and recommend practical solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, collaborate across teams, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning across Power Platform, analytics, AI, and data technologies.

**Skill Descriptors**
**Core Application Systems:**
Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications.
* Identifies key players, criticalities, roles, and responsibilities.
* Investigates application-related issues with both business and IT professionals.
* Recommends enhancements for a major application system or related subsystems.
* Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function.

**Problem Solving:**
Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

**Application Design, Architecture:**
Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.

Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Semantic BI - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - Semantic BI Engineer – Senior**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
  
  
**Role : Semantic BI Engineer**
**Experience Guide : 3-7 Years**
**Primary Skill Area :**
Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence
  
  
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: 3-7 years
* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.
* This role is not a traditional BI Developer. It is a Semantic BI Engineer and analytics architect who defines how trusted data is modelled, consumed and converted into actionable insight through governed dashboards, self-service analytics and AI-enabled decision intelligence.

**What We Look For**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Specialist - Corporate Audit
description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)**
Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Objective**
The Data Analytics Specialist will support the Corporate Audit function by developing and executing data analytics solutions to enable risk-based audits, SOX compliance, fraud detection, continuous auditing, and ERM initiatives. The role will focus on
**leveraging analytics-related tools**
(e.g., IDEA, Alteryx, Azure) and
**SAP data**
to deliver actionable insights and scalable audit analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Audit Data Analytics & Automation**

* Design, develop, and maintain models and/or workflows for audit analytics, fraud detection, SOX testing, and continuous auditing.
* Document the processes and procedures for models or workflows developed.
* Build, document, and maintain an inventory of audit analytics and use cases across business processes (e.g., P2P, O2C, Inventory, GL, etc.).
* Automate repetitive audit testing procedures to improve audit coverage and efficiency (e.g., test populations versus samples).
* Perform risk-based data analysis, including exception testing, trend analysis, and anomaly detection.

**Risk Monitoring, Fraud & ERM Support**

* Support fraud desk initiatives through advanced analytics and red flag identification using structured SAP data.
* Enable risk response monitoring aligned with ERM and Internal Audit priorities.
* Develop analytics to support management’s proactive risk identification and control effectiveness assessment.

**Technology & Data Enablement**

* Work directly with SAP source data (e.g., FI, MM, SD, Inventory modules) and ensure accurate data extraction and transformation.
* Leverage Azure or similar data platforms for large-scale risk analysis and enterprise analytics.
* Address data sourcing limitations and improve data reliability for audit consumption.
* Act as a subject-matter expert for analytics tools (e.g., IDEA and Alteryx), including workflow optimization and complexity review.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with Internal Audit, Compliance, IT, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to understand risk areas and data availability.
* Provide clear visibility on analytics deliverables, scope, and outcomes to audit leadership.
* Support follow-up discussions with stakeholders on analytics-driven observations.

**Governance & Capability Building**

* Define standards and governance for audit analytics development and documentation.
* Review and validate complex models and workflows developed by the team to ensure quality and sustainability.
* Support training and mentoring of auditors on the use and interpretation of analytics.

**Qualifications**

* Requires a bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5 - 7 Years of relevant experience in Data Analytics using Alteryx.

title: Specialist - Data Engineering
description:
**Role Description**
Location- Chennai, Bangalore
  
  
Experience - 5 to 8years
  
  
Shift- 2:30 pm to 12 am Hybrid
  
  
SAS Developer SAS to Snowflake Migration
  
  
**Job Description Data Analytics**
Role Snapshot
  
  
Role TitleSAS Lead Developer SAS Migration Specialist
  
  
FunctionData Analytics Data Modernisation
  
  
Experience 5 to 8 years with at 5 years handson in SAS
  
  
EngagementFulltime
  
  
Reports to Principal Architecture Data Analytics
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced SAS developer to join a legacy modernisation programme that is moving an established SAS estate onto Snowflake The person in this role will be the teams authority on what the existing SAS code actually does reading Base SAS and SAS macro programs tracing the data lineage behind them and translating that logic into Snowflake and modern ELT pipelines without changing business outcomes
  
  
This is a handson engineering role rather than a support role Expect to spend most of your time in code in reconciliation and in conversation with the business users who rely on the reports and datasets being migrated The work is well suited to someone who has lived inside a large SAS codebase and now wants to carry that knowledge into a cloud data platform
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Analyse and document the existing SAS estate Base SAS programs macros PROC SQL DATA steps scheduled jobs and stored processes and produce the code inventory complexity rating and dependency map that drive the migration wave plan
  
  
Convert SAS logic into equivalent Snowflake stored procedures and ELT pipelines preserving business rules joins aggregations formats and edgecase handling rather than reimplementing from assumption
  
  
Own data reconciliation between the SAS output and the Snowflake output build rowcount controltotal and recordlevel comparison scripts investigate breaks and sign off each migrated object against agreed tolerance
  
  
Reengineer SAS data access layers that read from files RDBMS sources and SAS datasets so they land in Snowflake through the programmes chosen ingestion pattern
  
  
Work with the architecture team on target data models translating SASera structures into curated Snowflake schemas that suit setbased processing
  
  
Tune migrated workloads for cost and performance warehouse sizing clustering pruning and query rewrites so that converted jobs meet or beat their existing batch windows
  
  
Engage report owners and business analysts to confirm interpretation of legacy logic retire redundant code instead of migrating it and support user acceptance testing through to cutover
  
  
Maintain migration artefacts mapping documents conversion standards test evidence and runbooks and mentor junior engineers on reading SAS code safely
  
  
MustHave Skills
  
  
Strong handson Base SAS SAS Macro PROC SQL and DATA step development including formats informats arrays hash objects and bygroup processing
  
  
Proven ability to read and reverseengineer undocumented longlived SAS programs and explain what they do in business terms
  
  
Advanced SQL with practical exposure to Snowflake virtual warehouses stages streams tasks time travel cloning and micropartition behaviour
  
  
Experience on at least one completed legacytocloud data migration with responsibility for validation and reconciliation not only code conversion
  
  
Working knowledge of Python or a comparable scripting language for conversion accelerators automated comparison and repetitive refactoring
  
  
Comfortable with version control structured testing and defect tracking in a deliverymanaged environment
