title: Junior APC Engineer - Process Optimisation Application (PXP)
description:
Join a Culture That Moves Fast — and Brings You With It.
  
  
At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.
  
  
When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.
  
  
If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it — Fuller is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
For more than 140 years, Fuller Technologies has helped industrial producers solve complex process challenges and operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. Our success is built on two foundations:
  
  
engineering excellence and long-standing partnerships with our customers.
  
  
As a Junior APC Engineer, you will carry this legacy forward by applying advanced process control, analytics, and AI/ML technologies to cement and mining operations worldwide. At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms — it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts.
  
  
You will be part of Fullers Process Optimisation Team, working with the ECS/ProcessExpert® APC toolbox and advanced control techniques such as MPC and AI/ML. Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption. This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility across the full APC project lifecycle — from processanalysis and model development to commissioning, optimisation, and long-term performance support.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities:**

* Perform process and data analysis using historical and real-time data from cement and minerals plants to identify optimisation opportunities.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy predictive models and soft sensors using linear and nonlinear AI/ML algorithms. Implement, validate, and maintain real-time APC applications using MPC, AI/ML, fuzzy logic, and PID control strategies.
* Estimate and quantify process improvement benefits using data analytics, supporting performance guarantees and technical proposals.
* Adapt, tune, and retrain models and controllers to ensure sustained performance and operational stability. Define and implement process control strategies, including configuration and commissioning of APC solutions.
* Fine-tune MPC, fuzzy, and PID controllers to achieve guaranteed performance targets related to productivity, energy efficiency, and stability.
* Support system integration activities, including hardware selection, software installation, and connectivity with PLCs, DCS, and historians.
* Collaborate with project managers and customer teams to ensure APC projects are delivered on schedule and to specification.
* Provide training and technical mentoring to customer engineers on data analytics and AI/ML applications within the ECS/ProcessExpert® platform.
* Evaluate emerging developments in advanced analytics and non-linear modelling to continuously improve APC applications.
* Contribute across the broader APC lifecycle, including sales support, product development, feature testing, and service support as required.

**You bring**

* Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Process Control, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applied to industrial processes.
* Proven experience in data mining, statistical modelling, model deployment, and real-time implementation.
* Background in process manufacturing industries; cement and minerals process knowledge is a strong advantage.
* Solid understanding of process optimisation, control strategy development, and benefit analysis.
* Experience with industrial data connectivity and historians, including SQL, MQTT, PLCs, DCS, and modern data platforms.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and data analytics tools commonly used in process industries, including: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Databricks
* Willingness to travel (50–70%) within India and internationally for commissioning, pilot testing, customer engagement, and training.

*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Application and contact**
Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.

title: Master Data Quality Manager
description:
**Company Description**
DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that helps organizations in the chemical and life sciences industries accelerate digital transformation. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to improve processes across research, development, laboratories, manufacturing, and operations. Its services span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT also provides data stewardship, integration, and knowledge management, supported by strong capabilities in platforms such as SAP Signavio, LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM tools. The mission is to make scientific processes more connected, intelligent, data-driven, and scalable for clients worldwide.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a technically strong professional with a background in chemistry, materials science or a related discipline to support our client in profiling the quality, consistency and reliability of formulation, materials and testing data. The role combines scientific domain knowledge with hands-on data quality management. You will work with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D specialists and other business stakeholders to review and profile data, identify inconsistencies, coordinate data cleansing and improve the quality of information used across the organisation.The ideal candidate has practical experience in a laboratory environment, particularly in formulation development, materials testing or product development, and understands how formulation and testing data are generated, recorded, interpreted and maintained.

You should be comfortable working directly with data as well as engaging with subject-matter experts to investigate issues, validate information and ensure that data is accurate, complete, consistent and fit for purpose.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Data quality monitoring**

* Monitor and assess the quality of formulation, materials, raw material, test methods and related technical data.
* Perform data profiling and quality checks to identify missing information, inconsistencies, duplicate records, incorrect attributes and deviations from agreed standards.
* Review formulation and materials records to assess completeness, consistency and accuracy against technical requirements and established data definitions.
* Identify data anomalies and investigate discrepancies in formulation information, material properties, test results and associated records.
* Develop and maintain data quality rules, validation checks and monitoring processes.
* Track data quality metrics and identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.

**2. Data Cleansing and Remediation**

* Coordinate data clean-up and remediation activities to improve the quality and consistency of existing datasets.
* Work closely with formulation scientists, laboratory personnel, materials specialists and data owners to investigate and resolve data discrepancies.
* Validate corrections with relevant subject-matter experts to ensure that changes are scientifically appropriate and accurately reflect the underlying technical information.
* Identify root causes of recurring data quality issues and recommend preventive measures.
* Maintain clear records of identified issues, corrective actions, decisions and resolution status.
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure that outstanding data issues are resolved in a timely manner.

**3. Scientific and Technical Data understanding**

* Apply knowledge of chemistry, materials science and laboratory practices to understand the context and meaning of technical data.
* Understand how formulations are developed, tested, evaluated and documented in a laboratory or R&D environment.
* Review formulation-related information, including raw materials, ingredients, compositions, material properties, test parameters and results, where applicable to the organisation's data.
* Engage with technical experts to clarify data definitions, resolve ambiguities and establish appropriate data quality requirements.
* Help distinguish genuine data quality issues from legitimate technical variations in formulations, materials or testing conditions.
* Support the development of consistent terminology, data definitions and standards for scientific and technical information.

**4. Data governance and standardization**

* Support the establishment and maintenance of data standards, validation rules and governance practices for formulation and materials data.
* Improve consistency in the way technical information is captured, classified, named, structured and maintained.
* Work with data owners and business stakeholders to clarify ownership, responsibilities and processes for maintaining data quality.
* Document data definitions, business rules, quality requirements and standard operating procedures.
* Promote consistent data management practices across relevant laboratory, R&D and business teams.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen data controls and improve the reliability of data at the point of creation.

**5. Stakeholder collaboration and user support**

* Act as a key contact for data quality issues relating to formulation, materials and laboratory information.
* Work directly with users to understand data-related challenges, clarify requirements and agree on corrective actions.
* Collaborate with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D, quality and IT or data management teams to resolve issues.
* Support users in understanding data standards and maintaining accurate and complete records.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Encourage accountability for data quality and promote continuous improvement in data management practices.

**6. Reporting and continuous improvement**

* Prepare reports and dashboards to communicate data quality performance, outstanding issues and remediation progress.
* Monitor trends in data quality and identify areas requiring further investigation or corrective action.
* Recommend improvements to data capture, validation, maintenance and review processes.
* Support initiatives to improve the accessibility, consistency and usability of formulation and materials data.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of data quality processes and practices across the organisation.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science or a related scientific or engineering discipline.
* Strong practical background in a chemistry or materials science laboratory, with particular experience in formulation development, materials testing, product development or a related R&D environment.
* Good understanding of how formulations and materials are developed, tested, characterised and documented.
* Experience working with technical or scientific data, including reviewing, validating, analysing or maintaining formulation, material or laboratory records.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify inconsistencies, investigate discrepancies and assess data quality systematically.
* Ability to work directly with laboratory users, scientists and technical stakeholders to clarify information and resolve data issues.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across scientific, technical and business functions.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to follow through on issues and drive improvements to completion.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in formulation development or testing involving chemicals, polymers, coatings, adhesives, specialty materials or other formulated products.
* Experience managing, reviewing or cleaning technical datasets, laboratory records, product specifications or formulation databases.
* Familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS), electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN), product lifecycle management (PLM), ERP systems or materials management platforms.
* Experience with Excel, SQL, Power BI or similar tools for data profiling, analysis, validation and reporting.
* Exposure to data governance, master data management, data stewardship or formal data quality processes.
* Experience working with R&D, product development, analytical testing, quality control or technical service teams.

**Process Overview\***
Global Operations Technology and Client Data Platforms: Development / Support/ testing of the technology solutions for the bank’s Marketing line of business applications.
  
  
**Job Description\***
The Analytics and Intelligence Engine (AIE) team transforms analytical and operational data into Consumer and Wealth Client insights and enables personalization opportunities that are provided to Associate and Customer-facing operational applications. The Big data technologies used in this are Hadoop /PySpark / Scala, HQL as ETL, Unix as file Landing environment, and real time streaming applications, like Spark Streaming, Kafka.
  
  
We are actively seeking a skilled Senior Hadoop Developer to develop and maintain insights, with strong technical expertise in Hadoop and related technologies, and who excels at collaborating with both onshore and offshore team members. The role requires both hands-on coding and collaboration with stakeholders to drive strategic design decisions. While functioning as an individual contributor for one or more teams, the Senior Hadoop Data Engineer may also lead and take responsibility for end-to-end solution design and delivery, based on the scale of implementation and required skillsets.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Develop high-performance and scalable solutions for Insights, using the Big Data platform to facilitate the collection, storage, and analysis of massive data sets from multiple channels.
* Utilize your in-depth knowledge of Hadoop stack and storage technologies, including HDFS, Spark, Scala, MapReduce, Yarn, Hive, Sqoop, Impala, Hue, and Oozie, to design and optimize data processing workflows.

**Education\***

* Graduation / Post Graduation

+ Not Mandatory

title: Manager - Governance
description:
**Job Summary**
**Purpose**
The role holder will be a part of the stress testing hub team.
  
  
Enterprise stress testing comprises the stress tests required by the Group, regions, country and risk management teams, and other senior stakeholders as required to inform Risk Appetite and the stress tests required by the Bank’s regulators.
  
  
The team has responsibility for the execution of the Bank’s stress test exercises internally and to external regulators. It is also the centre of excellence for all strategic changes and operational controls, compliance attestation and policy setting for stress testing in the enterprise. As such, this individual will be working as part of a cohesive “strategy and execution” function. The team sets and runs the production schedule for stress testing.
  
  
The intent of the hub is to primarily run central workstream production tasks and sub-tasks during the running of each stress test exercise utilising ITO (Group IT) supported technology and produce management reporting on the same.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Risk Data & Reporting Analyst to support our organization’s compliance with BCBS principles. This role will be responsible for enhancing risk data aggregation capabilities and ensuring consistent, accurate, and timely risk reporting in line with regulatory expectations.
  
  
Enterprise stress testing comprises the stress tests required by the Prudential Regulation Authority (ICAAP stress test, Bank of England’s annual concurrent stress test, Recovery Plan stress test and Reverse stress test) and the stress tests required by the management and Board to inform Risk Appetite. Country stress tests are performed for regulators like the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS)
  
  
The role reports to the Head of Stress Testing Governance and sits within the Enterprise Stress Testing team in Financial Planning & Analysis, which drives all enterprise stress testing initiatives in collaboration with teams across the Risk Function and in Group Finance, Group Treasury and the business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The role holder will ensure compliance with governance and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Specifically, The Key Responsibilities Would Include**

* Maintain and enhance the Enterprise Stress Testing (EST) governance framework, policies, standards, and procedures.
* Ensure stress testing processes remain aligned with regulatory requirements and internal governance expectations.
* Coordinate periodic reviews and updates of stress testing standards, guidance, and governance documentation.
* Monitor compliance with policy requirements and track any exceptions or deviations.
* Manage governance forums such as the Stress Testing Forum (STF) and Group Stress Test Forum (GSTF).
* Schedule meetings, prepare papers, agendas, and minutes.
* Track actions, decisions, approvals, and escalations arising from governance forums.
* Coordinate submissions for exercises such as ICAAP, BCST, Reverse Stress Testing (RST), Recovery Planning Stress Testing (RPST), VIR and regulatory stress tests.
* Manage regulatory queries, findings, and feedback.
* Coordinate responses to Internal Audit, External Audit, and Regulatory findings.
* Track management action plans (MAPs) and remediation activities through closure.
* Own and maintain the RCSA, control library, metrics, and risk assessments for the stress testing process.
* Ensure key controls are documented, tested, and operating effectively.
* Oversee governance of issues, incidents, control deficiencies, and remediation plans.
* Drive continuous improvement of the control environment.
* Maintain governance records, standards, operating procedures, and evidence repositories.
* Capture lessons learned from each stress testing cycle.
* Drive process simplification, automation, and governance enhancements.
* Promote best practices across Group and Country stress testing activities

**Risk Management**

* Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks associated with stress testing and governance activities.
* Maintain compliance with applicable risk management frameworks, policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Support Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), control effectiveness reviews, issue remediation, and audit activities.
* Escalate emerging risks, control deficiencies, and regulatory concerns to appropriate governance forums.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Stress Testing Team
* Key Risk colleagues
* Business leadership
* Key operations and technology partners / vendors
* Global Process Owner - Stress Testing
* Global Head, Stress Testing & Analytics

**Skills And Experience**

* Strong understanding of risk management, governance, regulatory, and control frameworks.
* Experience in stress testing, ICAAP, RCSA, audit, regulatory compliance, or related risk management activities.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex requirements and assess associated risks
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across business, risk, finance, and regulatory functions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare reports and presentations for senior management and regulators.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

title: Senior Infrastructure Platform Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking a hands-on Infrastructure Engineer to focus primarily on capacity and demand planning across data centers and public cloud. You will combine practical infrastructure experience with analytical thinking and strong internal customer relationships to translate future demand into clear capacity models, options, and timely decisions. This is a hands-on planning role grounded in how production infrastructure actually performs.
  
  
You will proactively engage engineering, application, product, and business teams, and help drive capacity and cost discussions with our existing FinOps engineers. Leadership owns approved forecasts, procurement and investment recommendations and decisions, and team backlog priorities. You provide the evidence, facilitate the planning cadence, and surface issues early.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build trusted relationships and proactive demand intake with internal customers, connecting delivery plans, workload changes, and business growth to infrastructure needs.
* Develop headroom, runway, growth, and scenario models for data center and public cloud capacity, documenting assumptions, uncertainty, dependencies, and changes in demand.
* Validate sizing against production evidence, peak demand, failover conditions, and performance requirements, rather than treating average utilization as sufficient.
* Account for hardware lifecycle and procurement lead times, cloud quotas, regional availability, and provisioning constraints when developing timing and capacity options.
* Run a leadership-sponsored planning cadence, maintain clear analytical inputs, and escalate approved threshold crossings for review. Thresholds trigger discussion, not automatic purchases.
* Help drive FinOps discussions with existing FinOps engineers: facilitate consumption, demand, capacity, and cost conversations; support consumption and spend forecast scenarios; and follow up with agreed action owners without controlling their backlogs.
* Partner on rightsizing, reclamation, total cost of ownership, workload placement, and commitment analysis. Validate potential savings against resilience and performance needs; FinOps specialists retain ownership of their practice and program.

**Requirements**

* Five or more years of practical infrastructure engineering or operations experience, with the technical depth and independent judgment expected of a senior engineer. We welcome candidates whose experience has been built in infrastructure operations.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and business teams in a global environment. A minimum of four hours of daily overlap with the US Eastern business day is required.

**Technical Requirements**

* Practical understanding of virtualization, compute, operating systems, storage capacity and performance (IOPS, latency, and throughput), networks, and resilience. Experience with platforms such as VMware or Nutanix and Windows or Linux is relevant; specific vendors are not required.
* Ability to interpret observability and time-series data, assess public cloud capacity constraints, and build demand forecasts using Excel, SQL, Python, or equivalent data analysis tools.

**Working Experience With**

* Sizing production workloads and validating capacity assumptions against real telemetry, workload behavior, service objectives, and operational constraints.
* Translating cross-team demand into planning inputs and collaborating with globally distributed teams to resolve gaps, dependencies, and competing assumptions.

**Must-Have Capabilities**

* Personal, practical infrastructure depth: explain how resources, bottlenecks, failure modes, and workload behavior affect usable capacity.
* Translate customer demand into defensible forecasts and scenarios, clearly separating evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, and risks.
* Facilitate constructive stakeholder conversations, challenge weak assumptions respectfully, and apply sound technical judgment to capacity and cost trade-offs.
* Collaborate effectively with FinOps engineers and service owners, making cost-aware options understandable without compromising performance or resilience.

**What This Role Is NOT**

* A general infrastructure delivery or ticket-queue role measured primarily by throughput, or a position intended to backfill on-call coverage. Operational experience informs the work; capacity and demand planning remain the primary focus.
* Ownership of approved forecasts, spend approval, procurement or investment recommendations and decisions, architecture, team backlog priorities, or the FinOps program. You develop analytical inputs and options in partnership with the accountable owners.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior specialist FinOps experience or certification, and experience supporting cloud cost optimization or commitment analysis. These are preferred, not required.
* Automation that improves telemetry collection, model inputs, or repeatable analysis. Terraform, Ansible, Git, CI/CD, and Kubernetes experience can be useful, but none is mandatory.

**How You'll Be Successful / Bottom Line**
You combine hands-on infrastructure knowledge with analytical judgment and strong working relationships to help our teams plan ahead. You work with internal customers and engineers to translate business demand into clear capacity requirements across data center and cloud environments, validate assumptions, and surface constraints early.
  
  
You help drive FinOps discussions in partnership with our FinOps engineers, connecting capacity needs, resource utilization, and cost tradeoffs without compromising performance or resilience. Your success is measured by the quality of your planning inputs, stakeholder engagement, and timely analysis that supports leadership's forecast, investment, and procurement decisions. Capacity planning is your primary focus; automation supports that work rather than defining the role.
  
  
At Tech Data, a TD SYNNEX Company, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.
  
  
**What's In It For You?**

* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.

title: Temenos Data Hub (TDH)
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior business analyst specializing in Temenos Wealth Suite within a global financial services environment translating complex wealth management needs into clear actionable solutions that enhance front office advisory workflows and portfolio servicing. Collaborate with cross functional teams in an office based role to deliver robust system capabilities that elevate client experience and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with wealth management stakeholders to interpret business objectives and translate them into detailed Temenos Wealth Suite requirements that drive efficient advisory and portfolio processes.
* Analyze existing front office workflows and identify optimization opportunities within Temenos Wealth Suite Front End to streamline user journeys and reduce manual interventions.
* Document comprehensive business requirement artifacts including process descriptions and use cases that provide clear guidance to configuration and development teams.
* Coordinate with product owners and technology teams to prioritize backlog items and ensure that enhancements to Temenos Wealth Suite align with strategic business outcomes.
* Validate functional designs and configuration changes in Temenos Wealth Suite through structured review sessions that ensure consistency with documented business rules and compliance standards.
* Develop test strategies for business scenarios and execute functional validation of Temenos Wealth Suite features to confirm accuracy of advisory tools and portfolio servicing functions.
* Conduct system demonstrations and walkthroughs for business users that explain Temenos Wealth Suite capabilities and encourage adoption of new digital behaviors.
* Provide detailed impact assessments for proposed changes in Temenos Wealth Suite Front End that highlight effects on downstream processes reporting and client servicing metrics.
* Facilitate requirement and design workshops with cross functional participants that encourage shared understanding and support timely decision making.
* Monitor production usage patterns of Temenos Wealth Suite dashboards and tools to identify data quality issues and recommend corrective actions that improve reliability.
* Align daily analysis activities with organizational purpose by enabling more transparent investment information that supports responsible wealth management in society.
* Produce concise status updates and analysis summaries that allow senior stakeholders to track progress of Temenos Wealth Suite initiatives and make informed prioritization decisions.
* Guide junior analysts through best practices in requirement documentation and Temenos Wealth Suite analysis ensuring consistent quality of business deliverables without formal leadership responsibilities.

**Qualifications**

* Possess professional experience of six to nine years in business analysis within financial services with significant focus on wealth management domains and advisory processes.
* Demonstrate strong hands on exposure to Temenos Wealth Suite including configuration understanding and practical usage in front office scenarios that support relationship managers.
* Exhibit proficiency in Temenos Wealth Suite Front End workflows with the ability to describe user interface behaviors in detail and convert observations into structured improvement suggestions.
* Show proven capability in writing precise requirement documents process flows and test cases using industry standard tools and methods appropriate for complex banking environments.
* Apply analytical thinking and numerical reasoning to interpret portfolio and client data ensuring that Temenos Wealth Suite outputs are accurate consistent and meaningful for business decisions.
* Utilize effective communication skills to collaborate with operations risk and technology colleagues and to clarify requirements without ambiguity for all participants in the change lifecycle.
* Display familiarity with agile delivery practices including refinement ceremonies and iteration planning which support incremental value delivery for Temenos Wealth Suite enhancements.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Rotork is the market-leading global flow control and instrumentation company, helping our customers manage the flow or liquids, gases and powders across many industries worldwide.
  
  
Our purpose is Keeping the World Flowing for Future Generations.
  
  
**Job Description**
Join our dynamic and specialised team in a key role that will truly make a difference. As part of this team, you will act as the bridge between raw Engineering data and actionable business intelligence, contributing to one of the largest MS Dynamics 365 rollouts globally.
  
  
You will be embedded within the deployment team, focusing on the integrity, analysis, and visualization of data to ensure an accelerated and successful rollout of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 solution. You will interpret complex data sets, identify trends, and provide the Engineering teams with the insights needed to optimize product structures and configurations. You will be responsible for ensuring that the global transition to D365 is backed by high-quality, validated data.
  
  
Main Responsibilities:
  
  

* Data Insight & Trends: Identify, analyse, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using statistical techniques to support D365 deployment.
* Reporting & Dashboards: Develop and maintain automated reporting capabilities (Power BI/Excel) to monitor data cleanliness and project progress.
* ETL Management: Extract, transform, and load (ETL) Engineering and CPQ data, ensuring seamless flow between legacy systems and D365.
* Data Quality Assurance: Define and implement data profiling and cleansing routines to ensure "single version of truth" accuracy through all migration test cycles.
* Stakeholder Communication: Present analysis results and data-driven solutions to senior leaders and internal customers to influence project timescales and strategy.
* Process Improvement: Locate and define new process improvement opportunities for data collection and management.
* Migration Support: Support production cut-over and provide early-life support by resolving data-related discrepancies in real-time.

Required Skills and Experience:
  
  

* Technical Proficiency: Strong knowledge of and experience with databases (SQL, etc.) and programming for data manipulation (Python, R, or ETL frameworks).
* Advanced Analytics: Expertise in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, SUMPRODUCT), MS access and data visualization tools like Power BI.
* Data Lifecycle Knowledge: Proven experience in data profiling, Master Data Management (MDM), data cleansing, and complex data migrations.
* Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to collect, organise, and disseminate significant amounts of information with meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.
* Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to identify, investigate, and resolve data anomalies within large, complex datasets.
* Communication: Ability to effectively communicate technical data findings to a non-technical audience and build relationships across global Engineering teams.
* Agility: Comfortable working to tight deadlines and adept at switching priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Qualifications**
This role is perfect for someone -
  
  
Who holds a bachelor’s degree in engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field and with a professional experience of 1-2 years. You should be someone who thrives in a process-driven environment, excels at delivering end-to-end data solutions, and is technically oriented yet capable of influencing project stakeholders. You are disciplined, proactive, and passionate about turning data into a strategic asset.
  
  
Required Competencies:
  
  

* Decision-Making: Able to make data-backed decisions quickly during critical project phases.
* Analytical Rigor: A methodical approach to troubleshooting and data validation.
* Adaptability: Able to cope with the unexpected and manage data issues effectively during system transitions.
* Collaborative Spirit: A team player who shares insights but demonstrates a high level of individual initiative.

description:
* Role: Data Management Analytics & Automation Specialist
* Keyskills: Data Analyst, Alteryx, Workflow automation, SQL
* Experience: 5-15 Years
* Loc: Chennai
* Role Overview

* We are looking for an experienced Alteryx Workflow Developer to design, develop, test, and maintain automated data workflows in a Banking and Financial Services (BFSI) environment. The role focuses on data preparation, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and process automation, with strong emphasis on workflow governance, auditability, and End User Computing (EUC) risk mitigation.

* The candidate will work closely with APAC onshore teams to translate business requirements into efficient, reusable, and well-governed Alteryx solutions.

* Key Responsibilities

* 1. Alteryx Workflow Development

* Design, develop, test, and deploy Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and process automation.

* Translate business requirements and functional specifications into scalable, reusable, and maintainable workflows.

* Automate manual and repetitive data processing activities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and consistency.

* Optimise existing workflows to improve performance and reliability.

* 2. Workflow Governance & EUC Risk Management

* Ensure workflows comply with governance, audit, documentation, and control requirements.

* Implement version control and maintain proper records of workflow changes, testing, and releases.

* Establish validation checks, audit trails, access controls, and error-handling mechanisms.

* Support workflow certification, ownership documentation, periodic reviews, and risk mitigation activities.

* Apply appropriate controls to minimise EUC risks and ensure workflows are reliable, transparent, and sustainable.

* 3. Data Analysis, Data Science & Reporting

* Perform data analysis and validation using Alteryx and SQL.

* Apply statistical analysis and predictive modelling techniques where required.

* Develop dashboards and visualisations using Power BI or Tableau to present workflow outputs and business insights.

* Support data-driven decision-making through accurate and well-structured reporting.

* 4. Delivery, Production Support & Documentation

* Investigate workflow failures, data discrepancies, and production issues, and implement appropriate resolutions.

* Prepare test cases, test evidence, technical documentation, operating procedures, and user guides.

* Identify and escalate requirement gaps, data quality issues, dependencies, and delivery risks.

* Conduct workflow walkthroughs, knowledge-transfer sessions, and provide ongoing production support.

* 5. Stakeholder Collaboration

* Collaborate with APAC onshore stakeholders to understand requirements, priorities, and solution expectations.

* Take ownership of hands-on development, testing, documentation, governance, and delivery activities.

* Participate in regional working sessions and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

* Manage multiple assignments and provide timely updates on progress, risks, and dependencies.

* Required Skills & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Proven hands-on experience in Alteryx Designer, including workflow development, testing, and optimisation.

* Experience in banking, financial services, or regulated data and analytics environments.

* Strong SQL skills and experience in data analysis, data validation, and reconciliation.
* Understanding of workflow governance, version control, audit requirements, and EUC risk mitigation.
* Experience maintaining workflow documentation, testing evidence, and operational controls.
* Ability to work with requirements defined by onshore teams and deliver solutions independently.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Flexibility to support Singapore working hours and collaborate with APAC stakeholders.
* Preferred Skills
* Alteryx Core or Advanced certification.
* Experience with Alteryx Server.
* Knowledge of Python or R, statistical analysis, and predictive modelling.
* Experience developing dashboards using Power BI or Tableau.
* Familiarity with governance and workflow management platforms such as Collibra or ServiceNow.
* Exposure to Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure Data Platform.
* Key Focus Areas
* Hands-on Alteryx workflow development and automation.
* BFSI data analytics and reconciliation.
* Workflow governance, auditability, and EUC risk mitigation.
* SQL-based data analysis and validation.
* Production support and collaboration with APAC stakeholders.

The primary responsibility of the GWFO team is to forecast future demand (Inbound /Outbound Call Volume, back-office process volume, etc.) and the capacity required to fulfill the demand. It also includes forecasting short-term demand (daily/ hourly) and scheduling the agent accordingly. The GWFO team is also responsible for collaborating with multiple stakeholders and coming up with optimal hiring plans to ensure adequate capacity as well as optimize the operational budget.
  
  
In this role, you will work along a highly talented team of analyst to build reporting and monitoring solutions to track key business metrics and support the workforce optimization activities.
  
  
You will be responsible for understanding the business need for reporting and monitoring of their workforce plans and developing intuitive, best in class, data-driven solutions leveraging the best tools for the job. You would work very closely with GWFO’s technology partners in getting these solutions implemented in a compliant environment.
  
  
You would be an SME in the group, supporting and mentoring the team on technical solutioning and should be ready to lend your hand to juniors when needed.
  
  
**Who You Are**
**Data Driven.**
A proven track record of enabling decision making and problem solving with data. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation and data driven approach.
  
  
**Excellent Problem Solver.**
You are a critical thinker, able to ask right questions, make sense of a situation and come up with intelligent solutions.
  
  
**Strong Team Player.**
You build a trusted relationships with your team members. You are ready to offer unconditional assistance, will listen, share knowledge, and are always ready to provide support as needed.
  
  
**Strong Communicator.**
You can communicate verbally and through written communication with clarity and can structure and present your work to your partners & leadership.
  
  
**Clear Results Orientation.**
You display a keen focus on achieving both short and long-term goals and have experience driving and executing an agenda in a demanding and fast-paced environment, with an eye on risks & controls.
  
  
**Innovative.**
You are always challenging yourself and your team to find better and faster ways of doing things.
  
  
**What You Do**
**Dashboarding and Visualization.**
You develop insightful, visually compelling and engaging dashboards that supports decision making and drive adoption.
  
  
**Flawless Execution.**
You manage and sequence delivery of reporting and data needs by actively managing requests against available bandwidth and identify opportunities for improved productivity.
  
  
**Data Exploration.**
Understand existing data & reporting by dwelling into multiple platforms scattered across the organization. You do what it takes to gather information by connecting with people across business teams and technology.
  
  
**Process & Controls Orientation.**
You develop strong processes, and indestructible controls to address risk and seek to propagate that culture to become the core value of your team.
  
  
**Be an Enabler.**
You support your team and help them accomplish their goals with empathy. You act as a facilitator and remove blockers and create a positive atmosphere for then to be innovative and productive at work.

title: Business Relationship Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Business Relationship Manager**
**Overview**
The Business Relationship Manager serves as the primary link between the AI team and business units across the organization. The role is responsible for gathering business requirements, prioritizing AI initiatives, supporting technology rollouts, and ensuring successful adoption and business value of AI solutions.
  
  
The role will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and Learning & Development to drive adoption, track usage and satisfaction, and address adoption risks.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibility**

* Own and maintain relationships with business unit stakeholders across the organization, serving as their primary point of contact for AI team engagement.
* Gather business requirements and user needs, translating them into prioritized, well-scoped inputs for the engineering team.
* Define, track, and report on adoption and usage metrics for deployed AI solutions — not just delivery status.
* Design and execute change communication and rollout plans for phased deployments, partnering with Learning & Development on training hand-off.
* Serve as the escalation point for business-unit feedback and concerns regarding AI tooling and automations.
* Identify early signals of adoption risk and drive corrective action before they surface as broader dissatisfaction.
* Facilitate prioritization discussions, bringing business context and stakeholder impact to bear on engineering roadmap decisions.
* Report adoption outcomes, business value, and stakeholder sentiment to executive leadership.
* Build and maintain a repeatable framework for onboarding new business units onto AI-enabled workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of experience in business relationship management, stakeholder management, product management, customer success, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience driving adoption of new technology or business processes.
* Experience defining and tracking adoption, usage, or satisfaction metrics.
* Experience gathering business requirements and working with technical/engineering teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple business units.
* Working knowledge of AI and automation capabilities and limitations.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 environment

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Experience in financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
* Experience supporting AI, automation, or emerging technology rollouts.
* Experience managing relationships across multiple departments.
* Change management certification such as Prosci ADKAR or CCMP.
* Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI-PBA.
* Product/program management certification such as PMP or CSPO.

* Regression testing

* Partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, Employee Experience, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver technical solutions.

* Collaborate effectively with global teams across APAC, EMEA, and North America.

* Mentor junior developers, analysts, and operational teams on Workday integrations, reporting, calculated fields, and platform best practices.
* Support knowledge transfer initiatives and promote self-service reporting capabilities within business functions.
* Contribute to team capability development through training, documentation, and peer coaching.

**Innovation & Productivity**

* Leverage modern productivity and AI-enabled tools to improve planning, analysis, testing, documentation, and operational efficiency.
* Participate in continuous learning and evaluation of emerging Workday technologies, testing tools, and platform capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of Workday experience with strong emphasis on technical development.
* Proven hands-on expertise with:
* Workday Studio
* Core Connectors
* EIBs
* RaaS
* Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST)
* Middleware integrations
* ISU management
* Strong experience developing and supporting Workday reporting solutions, including:
* Advanced Reports
* Matrix Reports
* BIRT Reports
* Dashboards and scheduled reporting
* Experience supporting full project lifecycles including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across HR, Finance, Payroll, and IT organizations.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments and Jira-based project management processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

title: Data Governance Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities:-**

**1. Data Governance Operations:**

· Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Bank’s Data Governance Framework.

· Coordinate data governance activities across Business Units (BUs) and Support Units (SUs).

· Facilitate collaboration with Data Owners, Data Stewards, and key stakeholders.

· Support governance forums, working groups, and committees through meeting preparation, reporting, and action tracking.

· Monitor adherence to data governance policies, standards, and procedures.

· Track data-related issues, remediation plans, and governance performance metrics.

· Prepare regular governance reports and management dashboards.

**2. Metadata Management, Data Lineage & KDU/KDE Governance:**

· Maintain and enhance the enterprise metadata repository and business glossary.

· Coordinate the identification, documentation, and approval of Critical Data Elements (KDEs) and Key Data Usage (KDU) processes.

· Facilitate the documentation and maintenance of end-to-end data lineage across systems, applications, and reports.

· Ensure lineage captures data sourcing, transformation, movement, consumption, and regulatory reporting requirements.

· Maintain data asset inventories and support metadata quality assessments.

· Monitor the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of metadata, lineage, and data ownership information.

· Collaborate with business and technology teams to resolve metadata and lineage gaps.

**3. Data Analytics & Regulatory Reporting Support:**

· Partner with business, analytics, and reporting teams to understand data requirements.

· Support data discovery and sourcing through metadata and lineage capabilities.

· Facilitate access to trusted, governed, and well-documented data for analytics and reporting.

· Assist in establishing consistent data definitions, standards, and business rules.

· Support regulatory reporting, management reporting, and strategic analytics initiatives through appropriate governance controls.

· Help ensure critical reporting data is traceable, well-defined, and properly governed.

**4. Data Governance Training & Awareness:**

· Develop and deliver data governance training programs for Business Units and Support Units.

· Design and maintain bank-wide e-learning modules covering data governance principles, policies, standards, and framework requirements.

· Conduct awareness initiatives to promote data ownership, stewardship, and accountability.

· Support onboarding and refresher training for Data Owners, Data Stewards, and other stakeholders.

· Monitor training participation and effectiveness.

· Identify opportunities to improve training content and governance awareness.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Regulatory Support:**

· Collaborate with Data Owners, Data Stewards, Technology Teams, Risk Management, Compliance, and Internal Audit.

· Act as a subject matter resource on data governance, metadata management, and data lineage practices.

· Facilitate communication and coordination across business and technology stakeholders.

· Support regulatory reviews, internal audits, and compliance assessments related to data governance and management.

· Assist stakeholders in addressing data governance observations and remediation requirements.

**6. Continuous Improvement & Data Governance Tools:**

· Identify opportunities to improve data governance processes, operating models, and governance controls.

· Promote automation and operational efficiency in metadata, lineage, and governance maintenance.

· Support the implementation, configuration, and enhancement of data governance platforms such as
**Collibra, Informatica, or equivalent tools**
.

· Drive improvements in metadata quality, lineage coverage, data ownership, and governance reporting.

· Contribute to the development of governance standards, procedures, and best practices.

**Required Skills & Experience**

· Experience in
**Data Governance, Data Management, Metadata Management, or Data Lineage**
within the banking or financial services sector.

· Strong understanding of data governance frameworks, policies, standards, and operating models.

· Hands-on experience with metadata repositories, business glossaries, data catalogs, and lineage documentation.

· Knowledge of Critical Data Elements (KDEs), Key Data Usage (KDU), data ownership, and data stewardship.

· Experience working with Data Owners, Data Stewards, technology teams, and regulatory reporting stakeholders.

· Familiarity with data governance tools such as
**Collibra, Informatica, Alation, IBM Watson Knowledge Catalog, or equivalent platforms**
.

· Understanding of data quality, regulatory reporting, and data management controls.

· Strong stakeholder management, communication, documentation, and presentation skills.

· Experience in developing training programs, e-learning content, or data governance awareness initiatives.

· Strong analytical, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.

title: Lead Employee Retention and Engagement
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Lead Employee Retention & Engagement will be responsible for developing and implementing organisation-wide strategies to improve employee engagement, strengthen workforce retention and reduce attrition across Muthoot FinCorp Limiteds geographically distributed operations.

The role will analyse workforce data and attrition trends, identify employees and locations with potential retention risks, and implement timely, targeted interventions. It will also lead employee-connect programmes, stay interviews, engagement surveys and other initiatives aimed at enhancing the overall employee experience.

The position requires close collaboration with business leaders and HR teams across India to understand workforce concerns, recommend corrective actions and ensure the effective execution of retention and engagement plans. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical, stakeholder-management and programme-execution capabilities and be willing to travel extensively.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Retention Strategy &Attrition Analysis***

Develop and implement organisation-wide employee retention strategies aligned with business objectives and workforce priorities.

Analyze attrition trends across roles, locations, tenure groups and business units to identify key reasons and high-risk areas.

Use employee data and workforce indicators to identify potential attrition risks and initiate timely preventive actions.

***Retention Initiatives***

Design and execute targeted retention programmes for critical roles, high-performing employees and locations experiencing high attrition.

Develop and implement engagement initiatives that improve employee experience, motivation, belonging and organisational commitment.

***Employee Connect Programmes***

Conduct structured employee-connect sessions, focus-group discussions and one-to-one interactions to understand employee concerns.

Design and conduct stay interviews with critical and high-performing employees to identify retention drivers and address concerns proactively.

Partner with business leaders, Zonal HR teams and other stakeholders to develop and implement role- and location-specific retention plans

***Employee Feedback and Action Planning***

Gather employee feedback through surveys and interactions, identify key concerns and ensure corrective actions are implemented within defined timelines.

***Retention Metrics and Reporting***

Monitor early attrition, regrettable attrition, retention rates and other relevant metrics, and provide periodic reports to management.

Define KPIs and evaluate the effectiveness and business impact of retention and engagement initiatives.

Prepare dashboards and presentations highlighting attrition patterns, employee concerns, programme outcomes and recommended actions.

***Best-Practice Implementation & Field Visits***

Identify successful retention and engagement practices and facilitate their adoption across regions and business units.

Travel extensively across locations to interact with employees and stakeholders, understand ground-level concerns and support programme implementation.

**KEY INTERACTIONS**

***Internal Stakeholders***

CHRO and Senior Management

Business Heads and Functional Heads

Zonal HR Teams, HR Business Partners, TA Team

Branch and Line Managers

Learning and Development Team

Compensation and Benefits Team

HR Operations and HR Analytics Teams

***External Stakeholders***

Employee-Engagement and HR Consulting Partners

Survey and HR Technology Providers

Industry Networks and Professional Bodies

**KEY DECISION TAKEN**

Identify and prioritise critical roles, employees, locations and business units requiring immediate retention intervention.

Determine appropriate interventions based on attrition risks, employee concerns and business requirements.

Design and implement employee-engagement programmes within approved policies and budgets.

Identify potential attrition cases and decide the level and urgency of preventive action required.

Determine the target groups, locations, frequency and format of employee-connect programmes and stay interviews.

Recommend corrective actions to address concerns relating to managers, workplace culture, career growth, recognition and employee experience.

Decide which critical or unresolved employee concerns should be escalated to HR or business leadership.

Evaluate programme outcomes and decide whether initiatives should be continued, modified, expanded or discontinued.

Determine the key insights, risks and recommendations to be presented to senior management for decision-making.

**KEY SKILLS & BEHAVIOURAL ATTRIBUTES**

Ability to develop and execute retention and engagement strategies aligned with organisational priorities.

Strong analytical skills to interpret attrition trends, employee data and engagement metrics.

Sound knowledge of employee engagement, retention drivers and employee-experience practices.

Excellent communication, presentation, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.

Strong problem-solving ability to identify root causes and recommend timely, practical solutions.

Ability to manage multiple retention and engagement initiatives across geographically distributed locations.

Proactive, adaptable and result-oriented, with the ability to anticipate and address potential attrition risks.

Willingness to travel extensively and engage with employees and stakeholders across India.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE**

Postgraduate degree or MBA/PGDM in Human Resources Management or an equivalent discipline from a recognised institution.

8-10 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3–5 years in employee retention, engagement or employee experience.

Experience in designing and implementing retention and engagement initiatives across multiple locations.

Strong exposure to attrition analysis, employee surveys, stay interviews and HR analytics.

Experience in a large, geographically distributed organisation is preferred.

Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and HR analytics/reporting tools.

Willingness to travel extensively across India.

description:

month-end closure by the 5th of the subsequent month. Collate bank statements, interest certificates and related documentation from banking partners.

* Behavioural Competencies

* Discipline in meeting recurring monthly and statutory deadlines without follow-up.
* Effective coordination and communication skills to work with warehouse, sales and audit teams.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to identify deviations, investigate root causes and escalate appropriately.
* Integrity and confidentiality in handling sensitive financial information.
* Key Performance Indicators
* Adherence to the month-end close calendar and MIS publication dates.
* Accuracy of reconciliations – nil unexplained differences carried forward beyond one cycle.
* Zero statutory defaults or interest/penalty on account of delayed TDS/TCS compliance.
* Timeliness and quality of audit schedules and query resolution.
* Reduction in reporting turnaround time through process and template improvements.

title: F - RC - Actuarial - UK PC - Staff
description:

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines
*.*
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Estimate actuarial liability for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 and Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 1+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx etc, will be a plus
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Data Engineering Manager / PFDE - Engineering Delivery Manager II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Data Engineering Manager – Product Forward Deployed Engineer**
**Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**
**About The Role**
Are you an experienced Data Engineer who has led the development of world-class software or digital products? Are you looking for an opportunity to expand your scope and lead products used by some of the biggest and most influential businesses around the world? If the answer to these questions is yes, we would like to talk with you.
  
  
ConvergeCONSUMER™ is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world’s largest professional services firm.
  
  
We drive value for our clients by optimizing decisions and actions at a level of granularity only made possible with today’s data and technology. ConvergeCONSUMER’s suite of solutions helps consumer-facing businesses prosper in a world being re-shaped by convergence, where the lines between industries, competitors and collaborators, consumers and suppliers, and even human and artificial intelligence have blurred. Our approach for addressing this complexity is simple: we combine Deloitte’s next-generation technology platforms with decades of experience in the consumer sector and a deep understanding of its unique issues and challenges to drive profitability and future growth for our clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our team. This role requires both technical fluency in data engineering and an analytical mindset capable of assessing data quality and real-world representativeness. The primary focus of this role is to establish expertise on our library of vendor licensed datasets, perform data pulls to extract insights from the datasets, link and join across datasets, assess the datasets and delivered insights for their validity and believability, and enable downstream data users, including account and product teams, to correctly leverage the data according to their project needs. The ideal candidate will have exceptional SQL and Python skills, expertise in Google BigQuery and PostgreSQL, and ability to convey complex data, concepts, and ideas in succinct, clear fashion to various business stakeholders. Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset is preferred.
  
  

* Work with Product Managers/Owners to understand how products can be used and should be implemented to solve client problems.
* Work with Project Managers to understand client requirements and brainstorm on solutions, implement the assets/products as applicable. Perform exploratory data analysis on large datasets (several GB to TB) to define analytical models and convert them into Model Ready Datasets (MRD)
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand analysis requirements and deliver solutions.
* Guide teams to perform exploratory analyses to assess new datasets, identify anomalies, and evaluate representativeness of real-world populations or behaviors across multiple engagements
* Build, test, validate and demonstrate analytical models through various relevant error metrics and calibration techniques. Present the forecasting accuracy results to the client team.
* Partner with external vendors to troubleshoot discrepancies, clarify data definitions, and improve feed quality.
* Ensure compliance with internal governance standards and data-sharing agreements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on external datasets, helping teams interpret and leverage them effectively for analysis and product development.
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.
* Use version control tools like GitHub to manage code changes and collaborate with the team
* Support and coach your team on best solutioning practices, development tools, and pathfinding and surveys for technologies
* Set technical direction, coach talent, enforce standards, align product/engineering/ops, and manage engagement risks
* Deploy advanced use of both SQL and Python coding languages in analyzing large data sets

**Reporting Relationships**
Reports to the AVP – Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE) and works at the intersection of data, product, and client delivery. Partners with US-based product and portfolio leaders to translate client needs into scalable data solutions, leveraging and validating complex datasets to generate actionable insights. Collaborates with Product, GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting teams across India and the US.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 10-14 years of relevant consulting experience (or equivalent) with a focus on storytelling and building Model Ready Datasets (MRD) based on analysis of large external and client data sets
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
* Work with Product Managers/Owners to understand how products can be used and should be implemented to solve client problems.
* Work with Project Managers to understand client requirements and brainstorm on solutions, implement the assets/products as applicable. Perform exploratory data analysis on large datasets (several GB to TB) to define analytical models
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand analysis requirements and deliver solutions.
* Guide teams to perform exploratory analyses to assess new datasets, identify anomalies, and evaluate representativeness of real-world populations or behaviors across multiple engagements
* Build, test, validate and demonstrate analytical models through various relevant error metrics and calibration techniques. Present the forecasting accuracy results to the client team.
* Partner with external vendors to troubleshoot discrepancies, clarify data definitions, and improve feed quality.
* Ensure compliance with internal governance standards and data-sharing agreements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on external datasets, helping teams interpret and leverage them effectively for analysis and product development.
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.
* Use version control tools like GitHub to manage code changes and collaborate with the team
* Support and coach your team on best solutioning practices, development tools, and pathfinding and surveys for technologies
* Set technical direction, coach talent, enforce standards, align product/engineering/ops, and manage engagement risks
* Advanced user of both SQL and Python coding languages with experience in analyzing large data sets

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree in a related field.
* Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset.
* Familiarity with cloud environments and deployment patterns.
* Knowledge of data engineering best practices and methodologies.
* Knowledge of feature engineering and practical experience working with data scientists on enabling production feature engineering pipelines at scale.
* Previous experience in a similar role within a fast-paced development environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Data Quality, EDA, MRD generation & Governance Ownership
* Cross-Functional Collaboration with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and External Vendors
* Vendor & External Dataset Management
* Technical Depth in SQL, Python, and Cloud Data Warehousing (GCP/BigQuery)
* Technical Leadership & Team Coaching
* Clear Communication of Complex Data to Business Stakeholders

**Why This Role Matters**
Product Forward Deployed Engineers bridge deep product and domain expertise with real client problems. They apply data and AI/ML capabilities to deliver scalable solutions, translate client learnings back into the product, and shape how Converge Consumer turns data into better decisions. It’s a hands-on path to becoming a leader at the intersection of product, data, and client impact.
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

This includes expense submission, audit, settlement, and compliance with the global travel policy and internal control framework.

The BPE actively identifies optimization opportunities, including automation and digitalization within the T&E landscape.
