* Proficiency in Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.
* Able to handle a variety of clinical research tasks.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills
* Professional use of the English language; both written and oral.
* Basic knowledge of drug, device and/or biologic development and effective data management practices.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a clinical, scientific or healthcare discipline.
* Dictionary medical coding (MedDRA and WHODrug)
* Understanding of CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM, etc.…)

title: Implementation Senior Analyst
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
The
**Senior Analyst**
is responsible for leading complex, customer-facing technical projects from discovery through delivery. This role partners closely with clients and internal teams to define scope, shape implementation strategy, manage day-to-day execution, and ensure successful outcomes across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong project management and client communication skills with enough technical depth to support data analysis, troubleshooting, and scripting work as needed. This role requires someone who can confidently lead critical customer conversations, manage expectations, navigate ambiguity, and drive progress in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Team Summary
  
  
The team supports customer-facing technical project delivery, implementation execution, and cross-functional coordination across internal and external stakeholders. Team members work together to manage complex engagements, resolve issues, support delivery quality, and improve customer outcomes.
  
  
The environment values clear communication, accountability, collaboration, and the ability to move between project management, data analysis, and technical problem-solving as needed.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end technical projects, including discovery, scoping, planning, execution, testing, implementation, and post-go-live support.
* Own customer-facing project conversations, including strategy sessions, status updates, risk management discussions, issue resolution, and executive-level stakeholder communication.
* Drive project scoping and strategy by translating customer needs into clear requirements, timelines, deliverables, and execution plans.
* Manage day-to-day project operations, including timelines, dependencies, action items, escalations, and cross-functional coordination.
* Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to align on goals, priorities, assumptions, and implementation approach.
* Analyze and validate data to support project decisions, troubleshoot issues, and confirm successful delivery.
* Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, validate, reconcile, and analyze data as needed.
* Develop Python scripts or utilities to streamline analysis, automate repetitive work, or support technical troubleshooting.
* Identify technical, operational, and data-related risks early and drive mitigation plans.
* Resolve complex issues involving data discrepancies, workflow mismatches, integration challenges, or process breakdowns.
* Document project scope, requirements, decisions, risks, and outcomes in a clear and organized manner.
* Work closely with engineering, product, operations, and client teams to unblock issues and ensure delivery.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities while maintaining high-quality execution.
* Recommend process improvements and contribute to scalable delivery methods and operational excellence.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them navigate technical complexity and make informed implementation decisions.
* Support onboarding or mentoring of teammates on project process, technical workflows, and best practices.
* Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, support scripting and troubleshooting, and improve project documentation while applying human judgment to verify outputs.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support team objectives and customer success.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Contribute to process improvements that strengthen delivery consistency and operational excellence.
* Support collaboration across distributed teams and time zones.
* Assist in maintaining effective project reporting, tracking, and communication practices.
* Participate in knowledge sharing and best-practice development across the team.
* Help support scalable methods for managing complex customer-facing technical work.

Expected Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in technical project management, implementation, healthcare IT, and data migration.
* Strong experience managing customer-facing technical engagements and critical stakeholder conversations.
* Proven ability to drive scoping, planning, and strategy for complex technical projects.
* Hands-on experience managing projects end to end in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in SQL for data querying, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Experience with Python scripting for automation, data handling, or technical analysis is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across geographies and time zones.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other standard project or data tools.
* Experience with Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar tools is a plus.
* Ability to adapt quickly, operate with urgency, and thrive in a collaborative environment.
* Experience in US healthcare, health IT, or EHR-related work is required.
* PMP certification is an added advantage.

* Champion process improvements and automation to enhance cycle times, accuracy, and executive management visibility.

* Lead performance management routines and convert results into actionable plans with owners and due dates.

* Champion process improvements and automation to enhance cycle times, accuracy, and executive visibility.

* Experience in Consulting
* Experience in Mergers and Acquisitions

* Contribute to strategic initiatives by offering financial expertise and analysis to assess investment opportunities and potential risks.

* Engage with essential stakeholders, senior management, and diverse levels within the sales organization to collect information and data points on key initiatives, facilitating the analysis of business performance.

title: Senior Data Governance Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior Data Governance Engineer**

  
  

**Location:**
Chennai, India

  
  

**Job Type:**
Full-time

  
  

**Function:**
Technology / Data

  
  

**Reports to:**
Raja Krishnamoorthi

  
  

**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We are building the world’s leading learning company by providing digital content, assessments, and services that support learners at every stage.

  
  

As part of Pearson’s Chief Technology Office (OCTO), the Keystone Data Governance team is responsible for enabling trusted, high-quality, and compliant data across the enterprise. We are transforming how data is governed by embedding automation, scalability, and modern data engineering practices into our governance model.

  
  

**The Role**

  
  

We are seeking highly motivated
**Data Governance Engineers**
to join our Chennai-based team. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building and scaling automated Data Governance capabilities across Pearson’s data ecosystem.

  
  

This role is primarily an
**engineering-focused position (approximately 70–80% hands-on engineering, 20–30% governance-related work)**
. The expectation is that strong data engineers will apply their skills to governance-focused use cases, while developing deeper expertise in data governance, metadata, and compliance domains over time.

  
  

You will work closely with global Data Governance leadership, data engineering teams, and external partners to design and implement solutions that operationalize governance at scale. This role is critical to reducing manual effort for business stakeholders while improving data quality, compliance, and discoverability.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Governance Engineering & Automation**

  

  
* Design and build automation solutions that operationalize Data Governance processes and reduce manual effort for Data Stewards.
  
  
* Translate governance policies into scalable, technical implementations embedded within data platforms (with guidance from senior team members as needed).
  
  
* Together with US-based Data Governance team, develop reusable frameworks and patterns that enable consistent governance adoption across business units.
  

  

**Collibra Platform & Integration**

  

  
* Configure, extend, and support the Collibra Data Governance platform, including workflows and API-based integrations.
  
  
* Integrate Collibra with enterprise data platforms to enable automated metadata ingestion, lineage, and governance workflows.
  
  
* Support enterprise data catalog, business glossary, and lineage capabilities.
  

  

**Metadata & Data Catalog Management**

  

  
* Support the build-out of integrations with data sources (e.g., RDBMS, data warehouses, data lakes, SaaS systems, PaaS systems) to support catalog ingestion.
  
  
* Enable automated data discovery, classification, and enrichment to improve usability and trust.
  
  
* Ensure metadata accuracy, completeness, and scalability across platforms.
  

  

**Data Quality Engineering**

  

  
* Design and implement data quality rules, monitoring solutions, and validation pipelines as needed to support OCTO team and Pearson business units.
  
  
* Build and manage data quality jobs to support profiling, validation, and issue detection.
  
  
* Collaborate with Data Stewards to define quality standards and remediation workflows.
  

  

**Data Compliance, Security & Privacy**

  

  
* Implement governance controls for data classification, access management, and privacy compliance.
  
  
* Integrate governance workflows with enterprise security and compliance tooling.
  
  
* Support initiatives related to regulatory and policy compliance requirements.
  

  

**Data Engineering & Integration**

  

  
* Develop and maintain data pipelines, APIs, and integration services supporting governance use cases.
  
  
* Integrate data across platforms using ETL/ELT processes and modern data engineering practices.
  
  
* Ensure pipelines align with governance standards for quality, lineage, and security.
  

  

**Collaboration & Delivery**

  

  
* Partner with global stakeholders and Data Governance leadership to deliver prioritized backlog items. Participate in stand-up meetings with US-based team, accept assignments from US team leads.
  
  
* Work closely with engineering teams and external partners (e.g., Deloitte) to industrialize governance solutions.
  
  
* Contribute to documentation, standards, and best practices for governance engineering.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  
  

**Required (Core Engineering Skills)**

  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related technical field.
  
  
* 3–6+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or related roles.
  
  
* Strong programming and data engineering experience (e.g., Python, SQL).
  
  
* Hands-on experience with APIs and system integrations (REST, microservices).
  
  
* Familiarity with modern cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks).
  

  

**Preferred (Data Governance & Domain Experience – can be developed on the job)**

  

  
* Understanding of data governance concepts including metadata, lineage, and data quality.
  
  
* Experience with data governance tools, preferably Collibra.
  
  
* Experience implementing data catalog, lineage, or metadata management solutions.
  
  
* Exposure to data quality frameworks and monitoring tools.
  
  
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, and compliance principles (e.g., PII, access controls).
  
  
* Experience designing and implementing data pipelines or integrating data from multiple sources.
  
  
* Experience working in global, cross-functional teams.
  

  

**Skills & Attributes**

  

  
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  
  
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  
  
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Self-starter with a focus on delivering scalable, high-quality solutions.
  
  
* Interest in developing expertise in Data Governance and enterprise data management practices.
  
  
* Commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
  

  

**What We Offer**

  

  
* Opportunity to contribute to a global, enterprise-wide Data Governance transformation.
  
  
* Exposure to modern data platforms, tools, and engineering practices.
  
  
* Collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented work environment.
  
  
* Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with local market standards.
  

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

  
  

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse workforce and creating an inclusive environment where all employees are valued and empowered.

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

title: Principal-Security Engineering
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
Verizon is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Principal Security Engineer to join our Data as a Service (DaaS) & Analytics team. In this senior individual contributor role , you will act as the technical North Star for our analytics engineering teams, driving the cloud-native automation strategies required to expose critical enterprise security data via robust APIs and interactive dashboards. This is an execution-focused, "hands-on with code" position. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Architecting and optimizing large-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi-terabyte analytical queries.
* Designing and implementing robust, low-latency data pipelines using GCP Dataflow services (Apache Beam) to ingest, transform, and aggregate batch and streaming data from disparate security sources into centralized data platforms.
* Designing and maintaining optimized data layers using the GCP Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL engine) to support high-throughput analytics and data consumers.
* Leading analytics engineers technically to architect and deploy production-grade automation solutions. Utilize GCP Cloud Run and Cloud Functions to build scalable, event-driven microservices and high-performance APIs that expose enterprise security data.
* Identifying opportunities to integrate AI/ML automation (e.g., Vertex AI, LLMs) to streamline manual data extraction, automate metadata tagging, and optimize pipeline orchestration.
* Driving the transition from standard visualization to a scalable data product model, establishing a comprehensive Looker dashboard catalog to streamline enterprise risk forecasting.
* Developing and maintaining a standardized semantic layer using LookML (Looker Modeling Language) to ensure data consistency, security access controls, and reusability across all security domains.
* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long-term security investments.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Proven experience architecting and developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform, specifically leveraging containerized deployments via Cloud Run and serverless computing via Cloud Functions.
* Deep technical mastery of Google BigQuery architecture, including nested/repeated fields, materialized views, and BigQuery Omni or ML capabilities.
* Hands-on experience building streaming and batch data processing pipelines using GCP Dataflow services.
* Advanced proficiency in writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Strong hands-on coding expertise in Python to perform advanced data analysis, data mining, DevSecOps automation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Familiarity with deploying AI-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.
* Experience utilizing visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Thoughtspot) to build data-driven stories tailored for business users at all levels.
* Experience embedding Looker visualizations directly into serverless applications or enterprise API frameworks is highly desirable.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or six or more years of work experience.
* Eight or more years of professional experience in data analytics, business analysis or comparable analytics position.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Ability to write SQL against a relational database in order to analyze and test data.
* Experience with modern DataOps/DevSecOps orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, CI/CD pipelines) applied directly to data engineering.
* Working knowledge on Threat, Risk and Vulnerability Management is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of securing cloud data delivery layers (OAuth, OIDC, API Gateways) and enforcing data privacy/governance standards.
* Cloud Certifications

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Experience in technology leadership, architecture, and Agile methodologies.
* Communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Problem solving skills to develop quick yet sound solutions to resolve complex issues.
* Experience in driving AI automation, delivering high performing and scalable applications.
* Experience with DevOps CI/CD processes to automate build and deployments.
* Experience mentoring and coaching diverse teams.
* Experience in identifying and analyzing and finding RCA for Errors and working with cross functional teams like SRE and backend team
* Experience with analytical tools and DBs like Postgres, Looker , ELK, ETL tools
* Recognizing, tracking, and communicating issues, accomplishments, milestones to the team and business partners.
* Professional Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification.
* Good presentation and communication skills.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting – Senior – Telecom Billing Analyst**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Telecom Billing Domain Analyst, you will help clients assess, design and implement telecom BSS billing solutions. You will bring strong telecom billing-domain knowledge and hands-on experience with platforms such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or comparable telecom billing and monetization products. If you have hands-on experience for Aria Billing Cloud, it will be an added advantage.
  
  
You will work with a strong focus on providing managed services and stable production operations of deployed billing platforms. You will work with telecom customer’s business, IT, finance, operations and vendor teams to translate business requirements into practical billing processes and solution designs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the telecom billing-domain specialist across production support, managed services, consulting, implementation and migration engagements. Hands-on experience in Aria Billing Cloud will be a definitive advantage.
* Investigate production billing issues, perform root-cause analysis and coordinate resolution across product, integration, data and operations teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy, operational efficiency, revenue assurance, customer experience and time to market.
* Work effectively with client stakeholders, product vendors, system integrators and distributed delivery teams.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops and document as-is and to-be billing processes, requirements, pain points, controls and business rules.
* Translate business requirements into functional designs, user stories, configuration requirements, interface requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Support billing transformation decisions covering platform consolidation, legacy modernization, product and pricing migration, integration rationalization and phased decommissioning.
* Define and review migration requirements for customer accounts, billing accounts, products, services, balances, open items and billing history.
* Support data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, mock migration, parallel billing, cutover and post-migration validation activities.
* Define and deliver solution designs, interface specifications, test strategies, test cases and migration-reconciliation reports for billing completeness and accuracy.
* Support system integration testing, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing, bill validation, cutover rehearsals and production support.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4–8 years of experience in telecom BSS, with significant techno-functional, hands-on experience in billing and revenue management.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major billing platform such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or an equivalent platform. Hands-on experience on Aria Billing will be a definitive advantage.
* Strong understanding of the telecom billing lifecycle, including customer and billing-account management, product and pricing configuration, usage processing, rating, recurring and one-time charges, bill calculation, invoicing, taxation, payments, adjustments, collections and dunning.
* Hands-on proficiency in Java, XML, SQL, APIs, data-analysis tools and cloud environments is required.
* Should be willing to work in shifts
* Experience migrating customers, accounts, products, subscriptions, balances and billing history from one billing platform to another.
* Knowledge of billing data profiling, mapping, cleansing, mock migrations, financial reconciliation, parallel billing, fallout management and cutover validation.
* Experience in production support or managed services for billing products, including incident, problem, change and release management; bill-cycle monitoring; root-cause analysis; defect resolution; and SLA-based support.
* Understanding of integrations between billing and CRM, order management, mediation, charging, product catalog, payment, tax, ERP/general ledger, customer-care and reporting platforms.
* Working knowledge of TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open Digital Architecture and Open APIs, particularly billing-account and customer-bill management.
* Experience preparing functional specifications, process flows, business requirements, user stories, solution-design inputs and test scenarios.
* Experience in leveraging latest AI tools to deliver projects within time, budget and quality.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant TM Forum or billing-product certifications are an advantage.

**What We Look For**
Highly motivated telecom billing professionals who combine strong domain knowledge with hands-on delivery experience. You should be able to analyze complex billing scenarios, translate requirements into practical solutions and support clients through transformation, migration and production support operations while maintaining a clear focus on billing accuracy, revenue integrity and customer outcomes.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Assistant Manager - Reporting Production Expert
description:
**Description**
**Job Title:**
Assistant Manager
  
  
**Department:**
Asset Management – Investment Operations
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Reporting Production Expert
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The Reporting Production Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day execution of regulatory transaction reporting obligations across EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II covering both EU and UK jurisdictions, and ASIC Rewrite. The role sits at the heart of the first line of defense for regulatory reporting, ensuring that all reportable transactions are submitted accurately, completely and on time to the relevant Trade Repositories and Approved Reporting Mechanisms across jurisdictions.
  
  
Reporting to the Regulatory Transaction Reporting team, the Production Analyst works as part of a team with interchangeable resources, each expected to operate across all four regulatory regimes and across both EU and UK jurisdictions where applicable. This versatility is essential to ensure business continuity, balance workload across the team, and provide a single, consistent operating standard regardless of the reporting regime. For SFTR and MiFID II, the Analyst is responsible for the hands-on day-to-day production of regulatory reporting. For EMIR and ASIC, which are delegated, the Analyst is responsible for the oversight and monitoring of the production performed by the service provider, ensuring reporting obligations are met.
  
  
The role combines hands-on production (SFTR, MiFID II), oversight of outsourced reporting performed (EMIR OTC, ASIC), oversight of delegated EMIR reporting on ETD performed by clearing brokers, exception remediation, accuracy controls, reconciliations, pairing & matching, and reporting to senior stakeholders. It requires strong attention to detail, an in-depth understanding of regulatory reporting mechanics across EU and UK regimes, and the ability to challenge and monitor an outsourced provider as effectively as performing the reporting directly.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* OVERSIGHT & MONITORING OF OUTSOURCED REPORTING EMIR EU, EMIR UK, ASIC

Perform daily oversight of the EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC reporting production carried out by 3rd party Service Provider (SP), ensuring completeness, accuracy and timeliness of all reporting to DTCC.
  
  
Monitor 3rd party SP daily production, submission status and exception handling, and challenge the provider where standards are not met.
  
  
Review and validate the controls performed 3rd party SP, ensuring they are operating effectively and evidenced.
  
  
Reconcile the internal trade population against the reports submitted by 3rd party SP to identify missing, duplicated or incorrectly reported transactions.
  
  
Track and escalate persistent issues, recurring exceptions or SLA breaches by 3rd party SP to RTR team.
  
  
Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting second-line oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
  
  
Act as the point of contact for 3rd party SP on EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC production matters.
  
  

* DAILY TRADE AND TRANSACTION REPORTING ACROSS SFTR (EU AND UK), MIFID II (EU AND UK)

Execute daily production reporting, ensuring all reportable trades and transactions are submitted within the regulatory deadlines.
  
  
Monitor reporting platforms and intraday flows to ensure timely capture and submission of all reportable events.
  
  
Validate report content against source systems post submission.
  
  
Track submission status and ensure all reports reach a final accepted state by Trade Repository or ARM/APA.
  
  

* REJECTIONS AND EXCEPTIONS REMEDIATION

Investigate and remediate all rejections (NACKs) and exceptions raised by the reporting platforms and/or Trade Repository across EU and UK regimes.
  
  
Identify root causes (data quality, mapping, reference data, timing) and apply the appropriate corrective actions.
  
  
Make the necessary amendments and resubmit corrected reports within the regulatory timeframe applicable in each jurisdiction.
  
  
Maintain a clear audit trail of remediation activities for compliance and oversight review.
  
  

* DAILY AND MONTHLY RECONCILIATION

Perform daily reconciliation on SFTR, MIFID, across EU and UK scopes to identify missing, incorrect or duplicated reports, investigate breaks, and implement remediation actions to resolve reconciliation breaks.
  
  
For EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC, reconcile the internal data against 3rd party SP reported output as part of the oversight function.
  
  
Execute monthly reconciliations to validate the consistency between source data, and data submitted.
  
  
Document reconciliation results and escalate unresolved breaks to the Regulatory Transactions Reporting team with proposed resolution actions and timeline.
  
  

* OVERSIGHT OF DELEGATED EMIR REPORTING ON ETD SCOPE PERFORMED BY CLEARING BROKERS

Validate completeness, accuracy and timeliness of reports submitted by clearing brokers.
  
  
Engage directly with clearing brokers to investigate discrepancies, request amendments and ensure corrections are made within the regulatory timeframe.
  
  
Track and escalate persistent issues or recurring reporting failures to RTR team.
  
  
Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting RTR oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
  
  

* PAIRING AND MATCHING

Investigate and resolve unpaired or unmatched transactions across EU and UK regimes, engaging directly with counterparties where required.
  
  
Manage UTIs processing in line with internal procedures.
  
  
Monitor and secure pairing and matching rates as a key indicator of reporting quality.
  
  

* REPORTING TO RTR TEAM

Prepare and share daily statistics and dashboards for all jurisdictions (EU and UK for EMIR/MIFID/SFTR and ASIC) covering reported volumes, pairing and matching rates, accepted volumes, rejection rates and remediated volumes.
  
  
Highlight emerging/faced issues, trends or risks to the RTR team in a timely and structured manner.
  
  

* CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT AND KNOWLEDGE SHARING

Identify ad escalate recurring issues.
  
  
Maintain up-to-date procedures, runbooks and knowledge base for all four regulatory regimes.
  
  
Cross-train and support fellow team members to maintain full interchangeability across the team.
  
  
Stay updated with regulatory requirements changes and contribute to impact assessments when changes are announced.
  
  
**Specific Qualifications**

* MANDATORY:

Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in regulatory transaction reporting within the financial services industry (asset management, sell-side).
  
  
Solid understanding of regulatory reporting mechanics: report submission lifecycles, ACK/NACK handling, UTI mechanics, pairing and matching, lifecycle events and action types.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of at least one of EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II or ASIC Rewrite and the ability/willingness to acquire expertise across all four.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to monitor and challenge an outsourced reporting provider, including reviewing their controls, reconciliations and SLA performance.
  
  
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic) for reconciliation and reporting purposes.
  
  

* NICE TO HAVE:

Working knowledge of 2 regulatory regimes or more (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite).
  
  
Hands-on experience with platforms such as: Aladdin, TRAX (ARM/APA), Tri-Optima, DTCC, IHS Markit.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Versatility and ability to switch between regimes and reporting flows depending on workload.
  
  
Strong analytical and investigative skills, with ability to perform root-cause analysis on data quality issues.
  
  
Capability to translate reporting issues into clear messages for the RTR team and management.
  
  
Capability to produce presentations and KPIs representative of reporting quality and activities in scope.
  
  
Ability to support colleagues to achieve interchangeability, through documentation, knowledge sharing and active collaboration.
  
  
**Behavioral Skills**

* Active Listening
* Adaptability
* Ability to share/pass on knowledge
* Attention to detail

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s degree or Equivalent
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its
  
  
activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. title: RCF_IC_Factories - Planning
description:
Planning Site Roles (Master Job Description)Consolidated: Client Billing, MIS, Procurement, Scheduling, SubcontractingSECTION I: BASIC INFORMATIONJob Function: PlanningRole: Engineer / Manager
  
  

* Planning
* SiteJob Family: PlanningSECTION II: ROLE SUMMARY (Purpose of the Role)The Planning Site team is responsible for the end-to-end management of project timelines, resources, and financial documentation. These roles (covering Client Billing, MIS, Procurement, Scheduling, and Subcontracting) ensures project delivery through accurate quantity surveying, structured progress reporting (DPR/WPR/MPR), and the synchronization of material procurement with construction schedules. These roles serves as a vital link between site execution and project leadership, ensuring that progress is tracked, delays are mitigated, and billing is submitted in accordance with contractual milestones.SECTION III: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES / ACCOUNTABILITIES
* Client Billing & Quantity SurveyingPrepare monthly and milestone-based Running Account (RA) bills for submission to the client based on verified site progress, BOQs, and contract provisions.Coordinate with site execution teams to collect daily progress data, conduct physical measurement verification, and maintain updated measurement sheets.Review and interpret contractual billing clauses, milestone definitions, and item rate structures to ensure accurate and timely billing submissions.Assist in developing and updating the project’s billing plan linked with construction schedules, milestone timelines, and cash flow projections.Reconcile quantities between client-approved GFC drawings, BOQs, and site execution to avoid duplication or shortfall in billing.
* MIS & Monthly ReportingCollect and consolidate daily, weekly, and monthly progress data from execution, quality, safety, and stores teams, ensuring accuracy and completeness.Prepare DPRs, WPRs, and MPRs in standardized formats, covering physical progress, financial progress, manpower deployment, material consumption, and work front status.Support the planning team in updating construction schedules (Primavera/MS Project) and extract relevant data to reflect in MIS reports.Coordinate with site teams to obtain actual vs. planned progress updates, including milestone achievements, critical activity status, and pending approvals.Develop and maintain structured MIS trackers for material reconciliation, productivity metrics, subcontractor performance, and delay logs.

title: Assistant Vice President - Transaction Reporting
description:
**Job Title:**
Assistant Vice President – Regulatory Transaction Reporting & Data Services
  
  
**Department:**
Asset Management – Investment Operations / Reporting
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Asset Management Reporting and Data Services are responsible for the end-to-end integrity of the data lifecycle. This includes transforming validated investment, accounting, pricing, and reference data into accurate, timely, and compliant reports for clients, regulators, and internal stakeholders. The function ensures that regulatory transaction reporting (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC) is executed with precision while maintaining the robust data foundations required for institutional-grade reporting.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The Assistant Vice President (AVP) serves as a strategic leader and dual-function controller within the Regulatory Transaction Reporting (RTR) and Data Services ecosystem. The role is responsible for the governance, oversight, and continuous improvement of both the regulatory reporting framework and the underlying data management architecture.
  
  
The AVP is accountable for ensuring the "Golden Source" of data is maintained, managing the full data lineage from ingestion to regulatory submission, and driving the strategic roadmap for data quality and reporting automation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Direct Responsibilities**

* Strategic Oversight: Lead the end-to-end delivery strategy for regulatory transaction reporting and the data services lifecycle, ensuring all global SLAs and multi-jurisdictional requirements are met.
* Data Governance & Integrity: Act as the primary authority for data quality; establish and enforce standards for data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and consistency across all reporting streams.
* Regulatory Control Authority: Direct the oversight of both direct production (SFTR, MiFID II) and outsourced/delegated reporting (EMIR, ASIC), ensuring rigorous control over 3rd party Service Providers and Clearing Brokers.
* Critical Escalation & Incident Management: Serve as the senior point of contact for resolving complex regulatory discrepancies, systemic data breaks, and high-priority reporting failures.
* Quality Assurance Framework: Define and implement enhanced control standards for transaction pairing, matching, UTI management, and master data reconciliation.

**Contributing Responsibilities**

* Leadership & Talent Development: Provide strategic direction to Production Analysts and Data Processors; drive a culture of technical excellence, data literacy, and continuous professional development.
* Transformation & Data Engineering Oversight: Lead large-scale automation and digitalization projects; oversee the implementation of automated data validation rules and streamlined data ingestion workflows.
* Data Lineage & Traceability: Partner with IT and Data Engineering to ensure full end-to-end data lineage, enabling seamless audit trails from regulatory submission back to the original source system.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with senior leaders in Performance, Accounting, and Product teams to optimize upstream data flows and resolve systemic "root cause" issues.
* Audit & Regulatory Liaison: Lead the response to internal/external audits and regulatory inquiries, ensuring all data controls, governance documentation, and oversight evidence are robust.
* Change Management: Drive the implementation of new regulatory requirements (e.g., EMIR Refit) and system enhancements across the global reporting and data landscape.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**
**Technical Competencies**

* Advanced Regulatory Reporting Mastery: Deep expertise in the mechanics of EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, and ASIC, including submission lifecycles and exception handling.
* Data Management & Governance Expertise: Advanced understanding of Master Data Management (MDM), data sourcing, enrichment, and the management of investment data domains (Holdings, Pricing, Reference Data, Corporate Actions).
* Data Quality & Analytics: Ability to design data quality dashboards and use statistical methods to monitor data health and identify emerging trends/risks.
* Systems & Data Architecture: High-level understanding of the end-to-end data pipeline, including the connectivity between source systems, data warehouses, and regulatory interfaces (ARMs/APAs/TRs).
* Risk & Control Design: Advanced ability to design and implement complex control frameworks to mitigate operational, regulatory, and reputational risks.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategic Leadership: Ability to lead diverse teams through complex regulatory shifts and inspire a culture of data-driven accountability.
* Influencing & Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and effectively challenge 3rd party service providers and brokers.
* Decisiveness under Pressure: Ability to make high-stakes, time-sensitive decisions regarding regulatory deadlines and data integrity.
* Problem-Solving & Innovation: A proactive approach to identifying systemic gaps in data/reporting logic and implementing long-term technological solutions.
* High Accountability: Absolute ownership of the function’s regulatory standing, data accuracy, and global delivery quality.

**Specific Qualifications**

* Education: Post Graduate degree in Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline (MBA/CFA preferred).
* Experience: Extensive experience (5+ years) in Regulatory Transaction Reporting or Financial Data Management within an Asset Management or Sell-side environment.
* Data Mastery: Proven track record in managing complex data flows, performing high-level reconciliations, and validating data lineage and traceability.
* Leadership Track Record: Experience in managing operational teams and overseeing outsourced service providers/vendors.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Expert-level understanding of the evolving global regulatory landscape (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC).
* Process Excellence: Demonstrated experience in leading process improvement, automation, or digital transformation initiatives.

**Skills Referential**
**Technical Skills:**

* Advanced Regulatory Frameworks (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC).
* Data Governance, Data Lineage, and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.
* Strategic Risk Management & Control Design.
* Expert proficiency in Data Analysis tools (Advanced Excel, SQL/Python knowledge preferred) and Reporting Platforms (e.g., Aladdin, DTCC, Tri-Optima).

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strategic Thinking & Vision.
* Executive Communication (Reporting KPIs and trends to senior management).
* Change Leadership & Transformation.
* Advanced Conflict Resolution & Negotiation.
* Risk-based Decision Making.

**Education Level:**
Post Graduate degree in Finance
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai

Individuals will create basic level insights and recommendations in their area of expertise. Individuals in this role will continue to provide support to the analytics team members and begin to lead analytics efforts with low complexity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* This role is located within DataOps and supports Data scientists/Product owners working within the Domains of the Research Data Platform. Domains are functional units that are responsible for delivering one or more data products, often through data science algorithms, and supporting this work could lead to a wide range of different analytical activities.
* For example, you may be asked to dive into large datasets to answer questions from product owners or data scientists; you may need to perform large-scale data preparation (dataprep) in order to test hypotheses or support prototypes; you may be asked to review the precision and recall of data science algorithms at scale and surface these as dashboard metrics.
* You will need to have a keen eye for detail, good analytical skills, and expertise in at least one data analysis system. Above all, you will need curiosity, dedication to high quality work, and an interest in the world of scientific research and the products that Elsevier creates to serve it.
* Because you will need to communicate with a range of stakeholders around the world we ask for candidates to demonstrate a high level of English.

**Requirements**

* Minimum work experience of 3 years
* Coding skills in at least one programming language (preferably Python) and SQL
* Familiarity with common string manipulation functions such as regular expressions (regex)
* Experience with Pandas, Apache Spark/Databricks, Snowflake SQL, and Collibra, supporting data analysis, data governance, and metadata management
* Knowledge of basic statistics relevant to data science – eg. precision, recall, F-score
* Knowledge of visualization tools such as Tableau/Power BI is a plus
* Experience of working with Agile tools such as JIRA is a plus

**Stake Holder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with Data Scientists and Product Managers.
* Align activities with Data Scientists and Product Managers.
* Present achievements and project status updates, both written and verbally, to various stakeholders.

**Competencies**

* Collaborates well and works effectively as part of a team
* Takes initiative and is proactive in suggesting approaches or solutions to problems
* Drives for results by taking a task to a polished conclusion

**Key Results**

* Understand the requirements of a given task
* Identify, gather, prepare and refine data
* Interpret and understand large data sets
* Report findings to stakeholders through effective story telling
* Formulate recommendations and requirements
* Identify and address new opportunities

**Working For You**
We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

title: Marketing Business Analyst
description:

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

**The Team & Role**

**Marketing Business Analyst**
to serve as a strategic partner to Marketing Executive Leadership. This role will transform complex demand, marketing, customer, and revenue data into actionable insights that drive investment decisions, optimize performance, and elevate executive decision-making.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep analytical expertise, advanced SQL skills, modern AI workflows, and exceptional business acumen. They are comfortable moving between detailed data analysis and executive-level storytelling, helping leaders understand not just what happened, but why it happened and what actions to take next.
  
  
**This is a hybrid position, so you'll work both remotely and in the Chennai office.**
Marketing Analytics & Performance Optimization
  
  

* Analyze campaign, digital, event, ABM, product marketing, customer marketing, and demand generation performance.

* Build attribution, funnel, and conversion analyses that drive marketing investment decisions.

* Design and maintain executive-level marketing performance frameworks, dashboards, and reporting.
* Develop KPIs and measurement methodologies that connect marketing activities to pipeline, revenue, customer growth, and business outcomes.
* Translate complex analyses into clear narratives and recommendations for executive audiences.
* Support quarterly business reviews, board reporting, annual planning, and strategic decision-making.
* Identify emerging trends, risks, and opportunities through proactive analysis.

* Own the marketing semantic layer, including KPI definitions, business logic, data dictionaries, AI-ready documentation, and reusable measurement frameworks that ensure consistency across reporting, dashboards, AI agents, and executive communications.

description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)**
Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Manager – Data & Analytics Operations**
will provide strategic and operational leadership for the function responsible for supporting, monitoring, governing, and continuously improving enterprise analytics platforms and reporting solutions. The role is accountable for service reliability, team performance, stakeholder outcomes, operational risk, and the transition of analytics operations to modern cloud platforms. The Manager will establish priorities, operating standards, and measurable improvement plans while ensuring alignment with business and technology objectives .
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in SAP BW, Qlik, and BODS, together with proven experience managing analytics operations, developing leaders, managing senior stakeholders, and driving service improvement across a complex enterprise environment. Knowledge of Azure Synapse and Databricks is highly desirable and will be considered a significant advantage.
  
  
As the organization transitions to Azure Synapse and Databricks, the Manager will own the operational readiness, governance, support model, monitoring strategy, capacity planning, and service transition for these platforms.
  
  

* Own the end-to-end operating model and service outcomes for analytics platforms, dashboards, data pipelines, and reporting solutions.
* Define and execute the operational strategy supporting the organization's analytics modernization roadmap, including service transition and migration initiatives involving Azure Synapse Analytics and Databricks .
* Establish, monitor , and improve SLAs, operational KPIs, service-health metrics, and management reporting; ensure corrective actions are implemented where performance is below target.
* Provide governance and executive oversight for incident, problem, change, release, and service-continuity management, including timely stakeholder communication and risk escalation.
* Drive prevention of recurring production issues by ensuring effective root cause analysis, remediation ownership, control improvements, and lessons learned.
* Lead workforce planning, performance management, succession planning, capability development, coaching, and engagement for the analytics operations team.
* Partner with business, product, architecture, security, infrastructure, and data teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, and communicate service performance, risks, and investment needs

**Qualifications**

* Requires a bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Requires 15–20 years of experience in the analytics domain, including substantial responsibility for enterprise analytics operations.
* Extensive hands-on and leadership experience across SAP BW environments.
* Worked on any reporting tools like PowerBI /Qlik
* Requires at least 3 to 5 years of people-management experience, including managing team leads or senior technical professionals.
* Worked extensively on Incident Management and release management
* Worked on Data Reconciliation and process controls
* Good Knowledge on SAP Functional modules like SD, MM, PP, FI
* Worked on BI tools like PowerBI /Qlik
* Possess excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Sr. Data Analyst
description:
**Job Description – Senior Data Migration Engineer**
**Company:**
MAKO IT
  
  
**Position:**
Senior Data Migration Engineer
  
  
**Experience:**
3+ Years
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai (Work from Office)
  
  
**Shift Timing:**
2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Department:**
Data Engineering / Data Migration
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Senior Data Migration Engineer with 4–7 years of hands-on experience in Python, SQL, ETL development, API integrations, and data migration.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing complex data migration solutions while ensuring data accuracy, performance, scalability, and reliability.
  
  
In addition to customer migration projects, the candidate will play a key role in developing and enhancing our
**AI-powered Data Migration Platform**
, focused on automating data extraction, mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and migration workflows.
  
  
We are looking for someone with strong technical ownership, problem-solving abilities, and a willingness to learn, experiment with, and implement AI-driven solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Data Migration & ETL Development
* Independently design, develop, and execute end-to-end data migration workflows.
* Build scalable and reusable ETL pipelines using Python and SQL.
* Handle data extraction and migration across databases, CSV, Excel, JSON, and REST APIs.
* Develop complex data mapping, cleansing, transformation, and loading logic.
* Implement incremental migrations, delta updates, and bulk data processing.
* Optimize migration scripts for performance and reliability.
* Identify and resolve complex data migration issues.
* Python Development & Automation
* Develop robust, modular, and maintainable Python applications.
* Build reusable components for data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading.
* Work extensively with Pandas and other Python data-processing libraries.
* Implement exception handling, logging, retry mechanisms, and error recovery.
* Optimize scripts for handling large datasets.
* Perform code reviews and guide junior engineers on development best practices.
* API & Database Integrations
* Design and implement REST API-based migration and integration workflows.
* Handle API authentication, pagination, rate limiting, and bulk operations.
* Troubleshoot API failures, data inconsistencies, and integration challenges.
* Develop complex SQL queries for transformation, reconciliation, and validation.
* Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MS SQL Server.
* AI-Powered Migration Platform Development
* Contribute to the architecture, development, and enhancement of an AI-powered Data Migration Platform.
* Explore and implement AI-assisted data mapping, field matching, and transformation recommendations.
* Develop automation components to reduce manual migration efforts.
* Evaluate LLM-based approaches for intelligent data processing and validation.
* Integrate AI capabilities into existing Python-based migration workflows.
* Work with the team to improve platform scalability, reusability, and maintainability.
* Continuously learn and adopt emerging AI technologies and development practices.
* Data Quality & Validation
* Design and implement automated data validation and reconciliation frameworks.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity of migrated data.
* Develop reusable validation scripts and exception reports.
* Investigate and resolve source-to-target data mismatches.
* Establish quality checkpoints for migration execution.
* Technical Ownership & Collaboration
* Take technical ownership of assigned customer migration projects.
* Analyze source and target systems and identify migration dependencies and risks.
* Participate in technical discussions, solution design, and estimation.
* Collaborate with Technical Leads, Project Managers, and implementation teams.
* Identify technical blockers early and communicate risks proactively.
* Prepare technical documentation, mapping specifications, and migration execution reports.
* Mentor junior engineers and support their technical development.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Python: Strong programming skills, modular development, scripting, automation, and exception handling.
* SQL: Advanced SQL queries, joins, subqueries, aggregations, data transformations, and performance optimization.
* ETL & Data Migration: Hands-on experience designing and executing end-to-end migration workflows.
* Pandas: Strong experience in data manipulation, transformation, and processing.
* REST APIs: API integrations, authentication, pagination, rate limiting, and error handling.
* Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL Server, or equivalent relational databases.
* Data Processing: CSV, Excel, JSON, XML, and structured/semi-structured datasets.
* Data Validation: Reconciliation, data-quality checks, exception reporting, and troubleshooting.
* Git: Version control and collaborative development.
* Debugging & Optimization: Strong troubleshooting and performance-improvement capabilities.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience in SaaS-to-SaaS or enterprise application data migration.
* Experience developing reusable ETL or migration frameworks.
* Knowledge of Docker, cloud platforms, and deployment practices.
* Familiarity with AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted automation.
* Exposure to AI frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
* Experience with fuzzy matching, intelligent data mapping, or schema matching.
* Understanding of data pipelines, scheduling, and workflow orchestration.
* Experience working with high-volume datasets and complex data structures.

Candidate Expectations
  
  

* Strong technical ownership and independent problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to understand migration requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Experience independently handling complex migration tasks.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to review code and mentor junior developers.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Willingness to learn, experiment with, and contribute to AI-driven migration technologies.
* Ability to proactively identify project risks and technical dependencies.
* Commitment to code quality, documentation, and timely delivery.
* Willingness to work from the Chennai office during the 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST shift.

Educational Qualification
  
  
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related disciplines, or equivalent relevant experience.
  
  
**Experience Required:**
3+ years in Python development, ETL engineering, data migration, or data engineering.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Data Migration Python Data Transformation API Integration ETL Basics Data Validation Pandas REST API SQL

title: Product Owner/Business Analyst (Hybrid)
description:
**About Team**
RX Global aims to create unforgettable experiences for attendees and exhibitors through organizing events. Innovation, creativity, and collaboration drive the company to offer exceptional services to clients.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Product Owner/Business Analyst is a hands on, outcome focused product role within RX’s At Show Products group within the Digital Products portfolio.
  
  
Working in close partnership with Senior Product Managers based in the UK, the Product Manager II operates within defined problem and solution spaces, contributing strong problem understanding, creative challenge, prioritisation support, and delivery phase judgement. The role focuses on execution quality, customer outcomes, implementation expertise, and facilitating learning.
  
  
Success in this role comes from caring deeply about whether products actually work for customers in live environments — and acting decisively when they don’t.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Customer & Problem Understanding**

* Build a deep, first‑hand understanding of customer needs, behaviours, and constraints in trade show usage contexts.
* Represent customer and business context within the delivery team.
* Frame problems clearly and test assumptions using both qualitative insight and quantitative data.

**Product Delivery & Execution**

* Partner with engineering, design, delivery management and data analytics to enable effective delivery within agreed scope and constraints.
* Provide sufficient context, clarity, and specification to unblock teams and sustain momentum.
* Make pragmatic trade‑offs and decisions during delivery, balancing value, feasibility, reliability, and time.

**Partnership with Senior Product Managers**

* Work closely with UK‑based Senior Product Managers as an execution partner and an SME who can constructively challenge solutions.
* Carry delivery realities, technology options, customer insight, and learning into roadmap and prioritisation discussions.
* Support the successful execution and monitoring of agreed product and technology work.

**Validation, Learning & Reliability**

* Validate product hypotheses through appropriate data, experimentation, and real‑world feedback.
* Monitor product behaviour in live show conditions, identifying reliability or adoption issues early.
* Feed learning back into iterative improvement and prioritisation cycles.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate effectively with commercial, product success, marketing, and sales teams to support adoption and operability.
* Contribute to coordinated releases and dependency management where user journeys span multiple teams.
* Lead product demos or reviews at key milestones, clearly articulating outcomes, trade‑offs, and learning.

**This Role Is**
**What This Role Is — and Is Not**

* Strongly delivery‑ and outcome‑oriented — get stuff done
* Focused on idea validation, execution quality, local leadership, and reliable value creation
* A critical, high-trust partnering role to senior product leadership
* Part of the core product team and integral to the RX India team creating impact
* Important to negotiating cross-team dependencies at the delivery level

**This Role Is NOT**

* Responsible for “what and why” at the level of commissioning new products and features
* Responsible for product vision or product strategy
* Required to invest much time beyond in backlog administration

**Requirements**
**Requirements and Backlog**

* Define and prioritise a value-based product backlog, including functional features and (with the Tech Lead) technical and compliance items
* Elicit and document business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Ensure stories are well-defined, appropriately sized, and sprint-ready
* Drive the solution within boundaries shaped by the PM — making active trade-offs on what gets built
* Elicit and define specifications for implementation with enough detail for the team to move forward

**Business Analysis**

* Identify assumptions, dependencies, edge cases, and operational impacts
* Distinguish documented fact from assumption and inference
* Create process maps and requirements documentation that are testable and traceable
* Provide clarification and handle requirements changes during sprint execution

**Communication and Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as the primary product point of contact for the delivery team
* Facilitate the team's understanding of business context — the what and why
* Engage stakeholders to understand needs and goals, and accurately relay that input
* Keep management updated on implementation progress via sprint demos and reports
* Tailor communication to different audiences (team, PM, business stakeholders)

**Agile Delivery**

* Participate actively in planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives
* Support the Delivery Manager in ensuring value delivery against requirements
* Support release readiness activities (pre-release support for Product Partners)
* Support the PM in discovery activities where needed

**Analytics and Data Literacy**

* Using dashboards (Mixpanel, PowerBI) to generate simple insights and inform trade-offs
* Assessing basic data quality; connecting product work to OKRs and outcomes

**Product and Domain Knowledge**

* Become the subject matter expert (SME) - how the product works end-to-end, system connections, and business value
* Respond appropriately to live event issues with suitable urgency

**Technical Awareness**

* Broad awareness of the technical architecture and platform constraints
* Ability to speak credibly with engineers about implementation boundaries

**Nice-to-Have**
**Discovery and Research Support**

* Applying common discovery tools (interviews, jobs-to-be-done, journey mapping) to directly support the PM's discovery responsibilities
* Understanding when to seek specialist data analytics support

**Go-to-Market Awareness**

* Understanding how product features contribute to revenue, retention, and commercial value
* Awareness of how products are rolled out to business units and show teams

**Experienced Using These Tools Or Equivalent**

* Jira
* Confluence
* Mixpanel
* Miro
* Sigma

**Work in a way that works for you**
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.
  
  
**Working for you**
**Benefits**
We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
  
  
Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
  
  
Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
  
  
Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
  
  
Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
  
  
Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance.
  
  
Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges.
  
  
Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority.
  
  
Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
  
  
Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
  
  
New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
  
  
Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
  
  
Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
  
  
**About Business**

With a presence in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events annually. RX is committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our people.
